routines.name: get_active_key
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pii_vault.get_active_key()
 RETURNS TABLE(key_id uuid, key_material text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT ek.key_id, ds.decrypted_secret
  FROM pii_vault.encryption_keys ek
  JOIN vault.decrypted_secrets ds ON ds.id = ek.vault_secret_id
  WHERE ek.is_active = true
  ORDER BY ek.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

routines.arguments: p_key_hash text, p_route text, p_limit integer
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admit_vendor(p_key_hash text, p_route text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 600)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_route NOT IN ('vendorPing','availability') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid vendor route'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM availability_consumers WHERE key_hash=p_key_hash AND active)
 AND NOT (p_route='vendorPing' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_sources WHERE ping_key_hash=p_key_hash AND active AND name=deployment_vendor_name() AND type='publisher'))
 AND NOT (p_route='vendorPing' AND public.deployment_feature_enabled('PING_PLATFORM_ENABLED')
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_sources WHERE ping_key_hash=p_key_hash AND active AND type IN ('publisher','aggregator')))
 THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('authorized',false); END IF;
 result:=consume_admission(jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('key','vendor:'||p_route||':'||p_key_hash,'seconds',60,'limit',p_limit)));
 RETURN result||jsonb_build_object('authorized',true);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.advance_contact_connection(p_contact_id uuid, p_tenant_id uuid, p_agent_id text, p_connected_at timestamp with time zone, p_direction text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_connected_at IS NULL OR nullif(p_agent_id, '') IS NULL OR
     p_direction NOT IN ('inbound', 'outbound') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid connection'; END IF;
  UPDATE contacts SET last_connected_agent_id = p_agent_id,
    last_connected_at = p_connected_at, last_connected_direction = p_direction
  WHERE id = p_contact_id AND tenant_id = p_tenant_id
    AND (last_connected_at IS NULL OR last_connected_at < p_connected_at);
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

routines.arguments: p_agent_id text
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.availability_snapshot(p_agent_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH ctl AS (
    SELECT coalesce((SELECT vendor_pause FROM vendor_controls
      WHERE tenant_id=public.deployment_tenant_id()),false) paused
  ), agents AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT a.agent_id, coalesce(a.agent_name,a.agent_id) agent_name,
      (NOT ctl.paused AND public.agent_inbound_routable(a.agent_id,a.status,a.available,a.active_call_sid)
       AND a.active_call_sid IS NULL AND a.status <> 'busy') available,
      CASE WHEN a.active_call_sid IS NOT NULL OR a.status='busy' THEN 'busy' ELSE 'offline' END unavailable_status,
      ARRAY[]::text[] licensed_states
    FROM agent_availability a CROSS JOIN ctl WHERE p_agent_id IS NULL OR a.agent_id=p_agent_id
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('any_available',count(*) FILTER (WHERE available)>0,
    'available_count',count(*) FILTER (WHERE available),'unavailable_count',count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT available),
    'total_count',count(*),'available_states','[]'::jsonb,
    'agents',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('agent_id',agent_id,'agent_name',agent_name,'available',available,
      'status',CASE WHEN available THEN 'available' ELSE unavailable_status END,'licensed_states',licensed_states)), '[]'::jsonb)) FROM agents;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_ping_source_control()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_sources WHERE id=NEW.source_id AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id)
 OR (NEW.campaign_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ping_campaigns
   WHERE id=NEW.campaign_id AND source_id=NEW.source_id AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ping source control scope mismatch'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND (NEW.tenant_id,NEW.source_id,NEW.campaign_id) IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.tenant_id,OLD.source_id,OLD.campaign_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ping source control scope is immutable'; END IF;
 NEW.changed_at:=clock_timestamp();
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_conference_media(p_participant_id uuid, p_call_sid text, p_generation integer, p_stream_sid text, p_owner uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_stream_sid !~ '^MZ[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$' OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM call_participants p JOIN call_conferences c USING(call_id)
  WHERE p.role<>'supervisor' AND p.id=p_participant_id AND p.twilio_call_sid=p_call_sid AND p.left_at IS NULL
  AND c.ended_at IS NULL AND p.stream_generation=p_generation) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 INSERT INTO conference_media_leases VALUES(p_participant_id,p_stream_sid,p_owner,clock_timestamp()+interval '20 seconds')
 ON CONFLICT(participant_id) DO UPDATE SET stream_sid=excluded.stream_sid,owner=excluded.owner,expires_at=excluded.expires_at
 WHERE conference_media_leases.expires_at<clock_timestamp();
 RETURN FOUND;
END $function$

routines.arguments: p_environment text
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_ix_upload(p_environment text DEFAULT 'test'::text)
 RETURNS SETOF ix_uploads
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.deployment_feature_enabled('IX_UPLOAD_ENABLED') THEN RETURN; END IF;
 IF p_environment NOT IN ('test','production') OR p_environment IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid IX environment'; END IF;
 -- Classification never consumes attempts or alters registration checkpoints.
 UPDATE ix_uploads q SET status='waiting_for_production'
 WHERE p_environment='test' AND q.status IN ('pending','failed') AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM enrollment_intakes i WHERE i.id::text=q.enrollment_key AND i.call_id=q.call_id AND i.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND i.is_test_enrollment);
 UPDATE ix_uploads q SET status='skipped_test_enrollment'
 WHERE p_environment='production' AND q.status IN ('pending','failed','needs_attention','waiting_for_production') AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM enrollment_intakes i WHERE i.id::text=q.enrollment_key AND i.call_id=q.call_id AND i.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND i.is_test_enrollment);
 UPDATE ix_uploads q SET status='pending' WHERE q.status='waiting_for_production' AND p_environment='production' AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM enrollment_intakes i WHERE i.id::text=q.enrollment_key AND i.call_id=q.call_id AND i.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND i.is_test_enrollment);
 UPDATE ix_uploads SET status='failed',last_error='lease_expired',retryable=false,updated_at=now()
 WHERE status='uploading' AND lease_until<now() AND attempts>=5 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enrollment_intakes i WHERE i.id::text=ix_uploads.enrollment_key AND i.call_id=ix_uploads.call_id
 AND i.tenant_id=ix_uploads.tenant_id AND i.is_test_enrollment=(p_environment='test'));
 RETURN QUERY UPDATE ix_uploads q SET status='uploading',attempts=q.attempts+1,lease_token=gen_random_uuid(),
 lease_until=now()+interval '30 minutes',updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM ix_uploads WHERE retryable AND attempts<5 AND twilio_recording_sid<>'pending'
 AND ((status IN ('pending','failed') AND next_attempt_at<=now()) OR (status='uploading' AND lease_until<now()))
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enrollment_intakes i WHERE i.id::text=ix_uploads.enrollment_key AND i.call_id=ix_uploads.call_id
 AND i.tenant_id=ix_uploads.tenant_id AND i.is_test_enrollment=(p_environment='test'))
 ORDER BY next_attempt_at,created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) RETURNING q.*;
END; $function$

routines.name: claim_media_stream
routines.arguments: p_call_sid text, p_attempt_id uuid, p_agent_id text, p_tenant_id uuid, p_inbound_call_id uuid, p_direction text, p_stream_sid text, p_owner uuid
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_media_stream(p_call_sid text, p_attempt_id uuid, p_agent_id text, p_tenant_id uuid, p_inbound_call_id uuid, p_direction text, p_stream_sid text, p_owner uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_owner IS NULL OR p_stream_sid IS NULL OR p_stream_sid !~ '^MZ[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$'
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telephony_call_attempts a
      WHERE a.id = p_attempt_id AND a.parent_call_sid = p_call_sid AND a.agent_id = p_agent_id
        AND a.tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND a.direction = p_direction
        AND a.inbound_call_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_inbound_call_id)
    OR NOT media_attempt_active(p_attempt_id, p_call_sid) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  -- Expired rows are bounded by the maximum concurrent leases and this sweep;
  -- a newer owner can never be released by an older stream's close callback.
  DELETE FROM media_stream_leases WHERE expires_at <= clock_timestamp();
  INSERT INTO media_stream_leases(call_sid, attempt_id, stream_sid, owner, expires_at)
    VALUES(p_call_sid, p_attempt_id, p_stream_sid, p_owner, clock_timestamp() + interval '20 seconds')
    ON CONFLICT(call_sid) DO UPDATE SET attempt_id = EXCLUDED.attempt_id,
      stream_sid = EXCLUDED.stream_sid, owner = EXCLUDED.owner, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
    WHERE media_stream_leases.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
      OR NOT media_attempt_active(media_stream_leases.attempt_id, media_stream_leases.call_sid);
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_operational_alerts(p_retry integer DEFAULT 300)
 RETURNS SETOF operational_alert_history
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('role',true)<>'service_role' OR p_retry<60 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Server required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY UPDATE public.operational_alert_history h SET attempted_at=clock_timestamp(),delivery_token=gen_random_uuid()
 WHERE h.id IN(SELECT id FROM public.operational_alert_history WHERE delivered_at IS NULL AND (attempted_at IS NULL OR attempted_at<clock_timestamp()-make_interval(secs=>p_retry)) ORDER BY occurred_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 20) RETURNING h.*;
END $function$

routines.name: claim_paragon_billing_jobs
routines.arguments: p_limit integer
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_paragon_billing_jobs(p_limit integer DEFAULT 2)
 RETURNS SETOF paragon_call_billing
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.deployment_feature_enabled('PARAGON_ENABLED') THEN RETURN; END IF;
 PERFORM seed_paragon_billing();
 RETURN QUERY WITH jobs AS (
 SELECT parent_call_sid FROM paragon_call_billing WHERE next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp()
  AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp())
 ORDER BY next_attempt_at,parent_call_sid FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT greatest(1,least(p_limit,5))
 ) UPDATE paragon_call_billing b SET lease_token=gen_random_uuid(),lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '2 minutes',attempts=b.attempts+1
 FROM jobs j WHERE b.parent_call_sid=j.parent_call_sid RETURNING b.*;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_ping_billing_jobs(p_limit integer DEFAULT 2)
 RETURNS SETOF ping_call_billing
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.deployment_feature_enabled('PING_PLATFORM_ENABLED') THEN RETURN; END IF;
 UPDATE ping_call_billing b SET inbound_call_id=i.id
  FROM inbound_calls i WHERE b.inbound_call_id IS NULL
   AND i.twilio_call_sid=b.parent_call_sid AND i.tenant_id=b.tenant_id;
 RETURN QUERY WITH jobs AS (
  SELECT parent_call_sid FROM ping_call_billing WHERE next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp()
   AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp())
  ORDER BY next_attempt_at,parent_call_sid FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT greatest(1,least(p_limit,5))
 ) UPDATE ping_call_billing b SET lease_token=gen_random_uuid(),lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '2 minutes',attempts=b.attempts+1
  FROM jobs j WHERE b.parent_call_sid=j.parent_call_sid RETURNING b.*;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coaching_call_eligible(c call_records)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT c.call_end IS NOT NULL AND c.call_type IN ('sales','enrollment','marketing')
 AND c.call_outcome IS NOT NULL AND c.call_outcome NOT IN ('pending','incomplete','test_call','duplicate_lead','no_answer','voicemail_left','wrong_number','bad_lead_data')
 AND c.call_outcome NOT IN ('enrolled','enrolled_pending_verification','partial_enrollment','sale_ancillary')
 AND NOT coalesce(c.enrollment_completed,false) AND NOT coalesce(c.app_written,false)
 AND nullif(c.enrollment_confirmation_number,'') IS NULL AND nullif(c.enrollment_code,'') IS NULL AND nullif(c.sunfire_code,'') IS NULL
 AND c.call_duration_seconds >= (SELECT (coaching_settings->>'minimum_talk_seconds')::integer FROM public.tenants WHERE id=c.tenant_id)
 AND (nullif(btrim(c.transcript_raw),'') IS NOT NULL OR jsonb_array_length(coalesce(c.transcript_diarized,'[]'))>0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.call_transcripts t WHERE t.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND (t.id=c.transcript_id OR t.call_record_id=c.id) AND nullif(btrim(t.transcript_text),'') IS NOT NULL))
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.enrollment_intakes e WHERE e.call_id=c.id AND e.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND NOT e.is_test_enrollment)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.policies p WHERE p.contact_id=c.contact_id AND p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND p.created_at>=c.call_start AND p.status IN ('pending','active'))
 -- The existing non-sale path finishes by skipping scoring. Never overlap an
 -- older in-flight scoring claim, even if a disposition was subsequently edited.
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.scoring_jobs s WHERE s.call_id=c.id AND s.status='pending' AND s.lease_until>clock_timestamp())
 AND coalesce(c.compliance_status,'not_requested') NOT IN ('queued','scoring','transcript_pending')
$function$

routines.name: commit_rts_ingestion
routines.arguments: p_tenant_id uuid, p_uploaded_by uuid, p_source_filename text, p_source_type text, p_file_hash text, p_row_count integer, p_records_skipped integer, p_warnings jsonb, p_rows jsonb
routines.result: TABLE(ingestion_id uuid, committed_at timestamp with time zone, records_created integer, records_updated integer)
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commit_rts_ingestion(p_tenant_id uuid, p_uploaded_by uuid, p_source_filename text, p_source_type text, p_file_hash text, p_row_count integer, p_records_skipped integer, p_warnings jsonb, p_rows jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(ingestion_id uuid, committed_at timestamp with time zone, records_created integer, records_updated integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_ingestion_id UUID;
  v_committed_at TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_records_created INTEGER;
  v_records_updated INTEGER;
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.tenant_agents agent
    WHERE agent.id = p_uploaded_by
      AND agent.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
      AND agent.is_active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'The ingestion user is not an active agent in this tenant.';
  END IF;

  IF jsonb_typeof(COALESCE(p_rows, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array'
    OR jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(p_rows, '[]'::jsonb)) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'RTS ingestion requires at least one normalized row.';
  END IF;

  SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
  INTO v_records_updated
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_rows) AS incoming(
    channel TEXT,
    carrier TEXT,
    product_line TEXT,
    agent_name TEXT
  )
  JOIN public.carrier_rts existing
    ON existing.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
   AND existing.channel = incoming.channel
   AND existing.carrier = incoming.carrier
   AND existing.product_line = incoming.product_line
   AND existing.agent_name = incoming.agent_name;

  v_records_created := jsonb_array_length(p_rows) - v_records_updated;

  INSERT INTO public.rts_ingestion_log (
    tenant_id,
    uploaded_by,
    source_filename,
    source_type,
    file_hash,
    row_count,
    records_created,
    records_updated,
    records_skipped,
    warnings
  )
  VALUES (
    p_tenant_id,
    p_uploaded_by,
    p_source_filename,
    p_source_type,
    p_file_hash,
    p_row_count,
    v_records_created,
    v_records_updated,
    p_records_skipped,
    COALESCE(p_warnings, '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  RETURNING id, created_at INTO v_ingestion_id, v_committed_at;

  INSERT INTO public.carrier_rts (
    tenant_id,
    channel,
    carrier,
    carrier_source_id,
    product_line,
    agent_id,
    agent_name,
    agent_npn,
    clerk_user_id,
    status,
    states,
    state_appointments,
    writing_number,
    certifications,
    cert_date,
    termination_date,
    effective_date,
    notes,
    source_file_hash
  )
  SELECT
    p_tenant_id,
    item.channel,
    item.carrier,
    item.carrier_source_id,
    item.product_line,
    item.agent_id,
    item.agent_name,
    item.agent_npn,
    item.clerk_user_id,
    item.status,
    item.states,
    COALESCE(item.state_appointments, '[]'::jsonb),
    item.writing_number,
    COALESCE(item.certifications, '[]'::jsonb),
    item.cert_date,
    item.termination_date,
    item.effective_date,
    item.notes,
    p_file_hash
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset(p_rows) AS item(
    channel TEXT,
    carrier TEXT,
    carrier_source_id UUID,
    product_line TEXT,
    agent_id UUID,
    agent_name TEXT,
    agent_npn TEXT,
    clerk_user_id TEXT,
    status TEXT,
    states TEXT,
    state_appointments JSONB,
    writing_number TEXT,
    certifications JSONB,
    cert_date TEXT,
    termination_date DATE,
    effective_date DATE,
    notes TEXT
  )
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, channel, carrier, product_line, agent_name)
  DO UPDATE SET
    carrier_source_id = EXCLUDED.carrier_source_id,
    agent_id = EXCLUDED.agent_id,
    agent_npn = EXCLUDED.agent_npn,
    clerk_user_id = EXCLUDED.clerk_user_id,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    states = EXCLUDED.states,
    state_appointments = EXCLUDED.state_appointments,
    writing_number = EXCLUDED.writing_number,
    certifications = EXCLUDED.certifications,
    cert_date = EXCLUDED.cert_date,
    termination_date = EXCLUDED.termination_date,
    effective_date = EXCLUDED.effective_date,
    notes = EXCLUDED.notes,
    source_file_hash = EXCLUDED.source_file_hash,
    updated_at = NOW();

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT v_ingestion_id, v_committed_at, v_records_created, v_records_updated;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.conference_event(p_call_id uuid, p_event text, p_payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE c call_conferences;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO STRICT c FROM call_conferences WHERE call_id=p_call_id;
 IF p_event='upgrade_requested' THEN
  UPDATE call_records r SET metadata=coalesce(r.metadata,'{}')||
   jsonb_build_object('transcript_source','deepgram_server','conference_prior_transcript',
    CASE WHEN r.call_direction='outbound' THEN coalesce(r.transcript_raw,'') ELSE '' END,
    'conference_prior_diarized',CASE WHEN r.call_direction='outbound' THEN coalesce(r.transcript_diarized,'[]') ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)
  WHERE r.id=p_call_id;
 END IF;
 UPDATE call_records SET metadata=coalesce(metadata,'{}')||jsonb_build_object('conference_events',
  coalesce(metadata->'conference_events','[]')||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
   'event',p_event,'at',clock_timestamp(),'payload',p_payload))) WHERE id=p_call_id;
 INSERT INTO telephony_events(tenant_id,inbound_call_id,twilio_call_sid,event,payload)
 SELECT c.tenant_id,a.inbound_call_id,c.parent_call_sid,'conference_'||p_event,p_payload
 FROM telephony_call_attempts a WHERE a.id=c.attempt_id;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.confirm_paragon_call_state(p_call uuid, p_tenant uuid, p_agent text, p_zip text, p_state text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM 1 FROM inbound_calls i JOIN lead_sources s ON s.id=i.lead_source_id AND s.tenant_id=i.tenant_id
 WHERE i.id=p_call AND i.tenant_id=p_tenant AND i.routed_agent_id=p_agent AND i.source_kind='publisher'
 AND s.name=public.bootstrap_vendor_source_name() AND s.type='publisher' FOR UPDATE OF i;
 IF NOT FOUND OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tenant_agents WHERE tenant_id=p_tenant AND agent_slug=p_agent AND is_active) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Paragon call unavailable'; END IF;
 IF p_zip !~ '^[0-9]{5}$' OR p_state !~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM zip_county_crosswalk WHERE zip=p_zip AND state_code=p_state) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid confirmed residence'; END IF;
 UPDATE inbound_calls SET confirmed_zip=p_zip,confirmed_state=p_state WHERE id=p_call AND tenant_id=p_tenant;
 RETURN reconcile_paragon_serviceability(p_call,p_tenant);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consumer_lifecycle_files(p_actor text, p_org text, p_contact uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE scoped jsonb; tenant uuid; result jsonb;
BEGIN
 scoped:=public.read_consumer_lifecycle(p_actor,p_org,p_contact,p_limit=>1,p_export=>true);
 SELECT tenant_id INTO tenant FROM public.resolve_deployment_subject(p_actor,p_org);
 WITH calls AS (SELECT * FROM public.call_records WHERE tenant_id=tenant AND contact_id=p_contact),
 files AS (
 SELECT 'recording_ingestion' AS source_table,r.id,r.first_seen_at AS occurred_at,coalesce(r.storage_bucket,'call-recordings') AS bucket,r.storage_path,r.sha256
 FROM public.recording_ingestion r WHERE r.tenant_id=tenant AND r.copy_status='stored' AND r.deletion_pending_at IS NULL AND r.storage_path IS NOT NULL AND
 (r.call_record_id IN (SELECT id FROM calls) OR r.inbound_call_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.inbound_calls WHERE tenant_id=tenant AND contact_id=p_contact) OR r.attempt_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.telephony_call_attempts WHERE tenant_id=tenant AND contact_id=p_contact) OR r.callback_call_sid IN (SELECT twilio_call_sid FROM calls) OR r.parent_call_sid IN (SELECT twilio_call_sid FROM calls))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'message_media',m.id,m.created_at,'message-media',m.storage_path,NULL::text FROM public.message_media m JOIN public.messages msg ON msg.id=m.message_id AND msg.tenant_id=tenant WHERE m.tenant_id=tenant AND msg.contact_id=p_contact AND m.storage_path IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'call_records',c.id,c.call_start,'call-recordings',c.recording_storage_path,NULL::text FROM calls c WHERE c.recording_storage_path IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recording_ingestion r WHERE r.tenant_id=tenant AND r.storage_path=c.recording_storage_path) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.retention_recording_purges p WHERE p.tenant_id=tenant AND p.storage_path=c.recording_storage_path AND p.status IN ('pending','held_missing','complete'))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT 'inbound_calls',c.id,c.created_at,'call-recordings',c.recording_storage_path,NULL::text FROM public.inbound_calls c WHERE c.tenant_id=tenant AND c.contact_id=p_contact AND c.recording_storage_path IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recording_ingestion r WHERE r.tenant_id=tenant AND r.storage_path=c.recording_storage_path) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.retention_recording_purges p WHERE p.tenant_id=tenant AND p.storage_path=c.recording_storage_path AND p.status IN ('pending','held_missing','complete'))

 ) SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f)),'[]') INTO result FROM files f;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consumer_lifecycle_rows(p_contact uuid, p_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(key text, type text, "time" timestamp with time zone, staff text, status text, summary text, evidence jsonb, details jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
WITH reshop_events AS (SELECT 'reshop_reviews:'||r.id::text||':reshop_review' key,'reshop_review'::text type,r.reviewed_at "time",r.reviewed_by staff,'reviewed'::text status,'Annual re-shop reviewed'::text summary,jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('table','reshop_reviews','id',r.id,'time',r.reviewed_at)) evidence,jsonb_build_object('outcome',r.outcome,'targetYear',r.target_year) details FROM public.reshop_reviews r WHERE r.contact_id=p_contact AND r.tenant_id=p_tenant AND r.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND public.deployment_feature_enabled('RESHOP_LIST_ENABLED')), listen_events AS (SELECT 'supervisor_listen_sessions:'||s.id::text||':'||s.mode key,s.mode::text type,s.started_at "time",s.actor_id staff,CASE WHEN s.ended_at IS NULL THEN 'active' ELSE 'completed' END status,CASE WHEN s.mode='whisper' THEN 'Supervisor whispered to agent' ELSE 'Supervisor listened to call' END::text summary,jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('table','supervisor_listen_sessions','id',s.id,'time',s.started_at)) evidence,jsonb_build_object('callId',c.id,'durationSeconds',s.duration_seconds,'endedAt',s.ended_at,'talkSeconds',s.talk_seconds) details FROM public.supervisor_listen_sessions s LEFT JOIN public.telephony_call_attempts a ON a.id=s.attempt_id AND a.tenant_id=s.tenant_id JOIN public.call_records c ON c.id=coalesce(s.call_id,a.call_record_id) AND c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id WHERE c.contact_id=p_contact AND c.tenant_id=p_tenant), recap_events AS (SELECT 'client_recaps:'||r.id::text||':recap' key,'recap'::text type,r.approved_at "time",r.approved_by staff,r.status,'Enrollment SELECT 'opportunity_stage_history:'||h.id::text,'opportunity',h.changed_at,h.changed_by::text,'recorded','Opportunity stage changed',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('table','opportunity_stage_history','id',h.id,'time',h.changed_at)),jsonb_build_object('fromStage',h.from_stage_id,'toStage',h.to_stage_id) FROM public.opportunity_stage_history h JOIN public.opportunities o ON o.id=h.opportunity_id AND o.tenant_id=p_tenant WHERE h.tenant_id=p_tenant AND o.contact_id=p_contact
UNION ALL
SELECT 'paragon_callback_tasks:'||t.id::text,'callback',t.created_at,t.assigned_agent_id,t.status,'Callback task',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('table','paragon_callback_tasks','id',t.id,'time',t.created_at)),jsonb_build_object('due',t.due_at,'closed',t.closed_at) FROM public.paragon_callback_tasks t JOIN incoming i ON i.id=t.inbound_call_id WHERE t.tenant_id=p_tenant
UNION ALL
SELECT 'followup_queue:'||t.id::text,'task',t.created_at,c.agent_id::text,t.followup_status,'Enrollment follow-up',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('table','followup_queue','id',t.id,'time',t.created_at)),jsonb_build_object('due',t.recommended_followup_date) FROM public.followup_queue t JOIN calls c ON c.id=t.call_id WHERE t.tenant_id=p_tenant
UNION ALL
SELECT 'compliance_scores:'||t.id::text,'review',t.created_at,t.agent_id::text,'recorded','Session compliance result',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('table','compliance_scores','id',t.id,'time',t.created_at)),jsonb_build_object('score',t.score,'callId',to_jsonb(t)->>'call_id') FROM public.compliance_scores t WHERE t.tenant_id=p_tenant AND (to_jsonb(t)->>'call_id' IN (SELECT id::text FROM calls) OR t.session_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.sessions WHERE tenant_id=p_tenant AND contact_id=p_contact))

UNION ALL
SELECT 'call_records:'||r.id::text||':enrollment','enrollment',coalesce(r.call_end,r.call_start,r.created_at),r.agent_id::text,'recorded','Legacy enrollment recorded',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('table','call_records','id',r.id,'time',coalesce(r.call_end,r.call_start,r.created_at))),jsonb_build_object('callId',r.id,'plan',r.plan_name,'carrier',r.carrier_name,'effectiveDate',r.effective_date,'confirmation',r.enrollment_confirmation_number) FROM calls r WHERE (r.enrollment_completed IS TRUE OR r.app_written IS TRUE OR nullif(r.enrollment_confirmation_number,'') IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM intakes i WHERE i.call_id=r.id)

UNION ALL
SELECT 'opportunities:'||o.id::text,'opportunity',coalesce(o.stage_entered_at,o.created_at),o.assigned_agent_id::text,o.status,'Opportunity stage recorded',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('table','opportunities','id',o.id,'time',coalesce(o.stage_entered_at,o.created_at))),jsonb_build_object('stageId',o.stage_id,'source',o.stage_change_source) FROM public.opportunities o WHERE o.tenant_id=p_tenant AND o.contact_id=p_contact
UNION ALL
SELECT 'follow_ups:'||f.id::text||':updated','task',f.updated_at,f.agent_id,f.status,'Follow-up updated',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('table','follow_ups','id',f.id,'time',f.updated_at)),jsonb_build_object('due',f.due_at) FROM public.follow_ups f WHERE f.tenant_id=p_tenant AND f.contact_id=p_contact AND f.updated_at>f.created_at
;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.conversely_run_results(p_run uuid, p_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(agent_id uuid, agent_name text, status text, reason text, call_id uuid, attempts integer, next_attempt_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT a.agent_id,e.name,CASE WHEN a.decision='skipped' THEN 'skipped' WHEN a.decision='failed' THEN 'failed'
  WHEN s.status='uploaded' THEN 'submitted' WHEN s.last_error IS NOT NULL OR s.status='failed' THEN 'failed'
  WHEN s.status='uploading' THEN 'uploading' ELSE 'pending' END,
 coalesce(s.last_error,a.reason),s.call_id,coalesce(s.attempts,0),s.next_attempt_at
 FROM conversely_run_agents a JOIN conversely_runs r ON r.id=a.run_id AND r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
 JOIN enrolled_agents e ON e.id=a.agent_id AND e.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
 LEFT JOIN conversely_submissions s ON s.id=a.submission_id AND s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
 WHERE r.id=p_run AND r.tenant_id=p_tenant ORDER BY e.name,a.agent_id;
$function$

routines.result: TABLE(tenant_id uuid, agent_id uuid, agent_slug text, clerk_user_id text, call_id uuid, carrier_name text, call_start timestamp with time zone, compliance_status text, score numeric, recording_id uuid, recording_sid text, account_sid text, callback_call_sid text, recording_channels smallint, enrollment_key text, already_submitted boolean)
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.conversely_week_candidates(p_week date)
 RETURNS TABLE(tenant_id uuid, agent_id uuid, agent_slug text, clerk_user_id text, call_id uuid, carrier_name text, call_start timestamp with time zone, compliance_status text, score numeric, recording_id uuid, recording_sid text, account_sid text, callback_call_sid text, recording_channels smallint, enrollment_key text, already_submitted boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT a.tenant_id,a.id,subjects.agent_slug,a.clerk_user_id,c.id,i.carrier_key,c.call_start,c.compliance_status,
 card.overall_score,r.id,r.recording_sid,r.account_sid,r.callback_call_sid,r.recording_channels,
 i.id::text,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM conversely_submissions s WHERE s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND s.twilio_recording_sid=r.recording_sid
 AND s.enrollment_key=i.id::text)
 FROM enrolled_agents a
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT ras.agent_slug FROM recording_agent_subjects ras WHERE ras.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND ras.clerk_user_id=a.clerk_user_id LIMIT 1) subjects ON true
 LEFT JOIN call_records c ON c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.agent_id=a.id
 AND c.call_start >= (p_week::timestamp AT TIME ZONE public.deployment_timezone())
 AND c.call_start < ((p_week+7)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE public.deployment_timezone())
 AND c.call_outcome IN ('enrolled','enrolled_pending_verification')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enrollment_intakes ei WHERE ei.call_id=c.id AND ei.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND ei.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT ei.is_test_enrollment)
 LEFT JOIN enrollment_intakes i ON i.call_id=c.id AND i.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND i.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT i.is_test_enrollment
 LEFT JOIN compliance_scorecards card ON card.id=c.compliance_scorecard_id AND card.call_id=c.id AND card.tenant_id=c.tenant_id
 AND NOT coalesce(card.is_thread_composite,false)
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT ri.* FROM recording_ingestion ri WHERE ri.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND ri.call_record_id=c.id
 AND ri.provider_status='completed' AND ri.copy_status<>'absent' AND ri.recording_sid IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY ri.recording_duration_seconds DESC NULLS LAST,ri.first_seen_at,ri.id LIMIT 1) r ON true
 WHERE a.is_active;
$function$

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.copy_recording_reference()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.call_record_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE call_records c SET recording_url=r.recording_url,recording_storage_path=r.storage_path
    FROM (SELECT recording_url,storage_path FROM recording_ingestion
      WHERE call_record_id=NEW.call_record_id AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
        AND provider_status='completed' AND recording_url IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY (copy_status='stored') DESC,provider_created_at DESC NULLS LAST,
        first_seen_at DESC,recording_sid DESC LIMIT 1) r
    WHERE c.id=NEW.call_record_id AND c.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.inbound_call_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE inbound_calls i SET recording_url=r.recording_url,recording_storage_path=r.storage_path
    FROM (SELECT recording_url,storage_path FROM recording_ingestion
      WHERE inbound_call_id=NEW.inbound_call_id AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND provider_status='completed'
      ORDER BY (copy_status='stored') DESC,provider_created_at DESC NULLS LAST,
        first_seen_at DESC,recording_sid DESC LIMIT 1) r
    WHERE i.id=NEW.inbound_call_id AND i.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.detect_inbound_duplicate()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.source_kind='publisher' AND duplicate_phone_key(NEW.from_number) IS NOT NULL
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_sources WHERE id=NEW.lead_source_id AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
 AND name=public.bootstrap_vendor_source_name() AND type='publisher') THEN
  -- Serialize same-identity inserts; the lookup sees the preceding committed call.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(NEW.tenant_id::text||':'||NEW.lead_source_id::text||':'||duplicate_phone_key(NEW.from_number),0));
  NEW.duplicate_prior_call_id:=find_duplicate_prior_call(NEW.tenant_id,NEW.lead_source_id,NEW.from_number,NEW.created_at,NEW.twilio_call_sid);
  NEW.duplicate_flag:=NEW.duplicate_prior_call_id IS NOT NULL;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

routines.name: duplicate_phone_key
routines.arguments: p_phone text
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.duplicate_phone_key(p_phone text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN digits ~ '^1[0-9]{10}$' THEN '+'||digits
 WHEN digits ~ '^[0-9]{10}$' THEN '+1'||digits
 WHEN btrim(p_phone) ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$' THEN btrim(p_phone) END
 FROM (SELECT regexp_replace(p_phone,'[^0-9]','','g') AS digits) d;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_compliance_uploads(p_call uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.deployment_feature_enabled('IX_UPLOAD_ENABLED') THEN RETURN; END IF;
 INSERT INTO ix_uploads AS q(tenant_id,call_id,twilio_recording_sid,enrollment_key,confirmation_code)
 SELECT DISTINCT ON(c.id,i.data->>'sunfireCode') c.tenant_id,c.id,coalesce(r.recording_sid,'pending'),i.id::text,i.data->>'sunfireCode' FROM call_records c
 JOIN enrollment_intakes i ON i.call_id=c.id AND i.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND i.completed_at IS NOT NULL
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT recording_sid FROM recording_ingestion WHERE call_record_id=c.id AND tenant_id=c.tenant_id
 AND provider_status='completed' AND recording_sid IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recording_duration_seconds DESC NULLS LAST,first_seen_at,id LIMIT 1) r ON true
 WHERE (p_call IS NULL OR c.id=p_call) AND c.call_outcome IN ('enrolled','enrolled_pending_verification')
 AND i.carrier_key='UnitedHealthcare' AND nullif(i.data->>'sunfireCode','') IS NOT NULL AND upper(coalesce(c.product_type,''))='MA'
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ix_uploads other WHERE other.call_id=c.id AND other.confirmation_code=i.data->>'sunfireCode' AND other.enrollment_key<>i.id::text)
 ORDER BY c.id,i.data->>'sunfireCode',i.submitted_at,i.id
 ON CONFLICT(call_id,enrollment_key) DO UPDATE SET confirmation_code=excluded.confirmation_code,twilio_recording_sid=excluded.twilio_recording_sid,
 status='pending',attempts=0,last_error=NULL,provider_message=NULL,retryable=true,next_attempt_at=now(),ix_state='{}',updated_at=now()
 WHERE q.status<>'uploaded' AND NOT(q.status='uploading' AND q.lease_until>now()) AND q.ix_state->>'callRecordingId' IS NULL
 AND (q.confirmation_code IS DISTINCT FROM excluded.confirmation_code OR q.twilio_recording_sid='pending' AND excluded.twilio_recording_sid<>'pending');
END; $function$

 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.deployment_feature_enabled('PARAGON_ENABLED') THEN RETURN; END IF;
  INSERT INTO integration_deliveries(kind,source_id,dedupe_key,payload,config_snapshot,expires_at)
  SELECT 'postback',s.id,'postback:'||r.id||':'||(r.metadata->>'wrap_up_saved_at'),
    vendor_call_payload(i.id),jsonb_build_object('field_map',coalesce(s.postback_field_map,'{}'::jsonb)),clock_timestamp()+interval '24 hours'
  FROM inbound_calls i JOIN call_records r ON r.id=i.call_record_id AND r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id
    JOIN lead_sources s ON s.id=coalesce(i.aggregator_source_id,i.lead_source_id) AND s.tenant_id=i.tenant_id
  WHERE s.active AND s.postback_url IS NOT NULL AND r.metadata->>'wrap_up_saved_at' IS NOT NULL
    AND (r.metadata->>'wrap_up_saved_at')::timestamptz>=s.created_at
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM integration_deliveries d WHERE d.dedupe_key='postback:'||r.id||':'||(r.metadata->>'wrap_up_saved_at'))
  ON CONFLICT(dedupe_key) DO NOTHING;
END;
$function$

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_recording(p_callback jsonb, p_attempt_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE rid uuid; ac text:=p_callback->>'AccountSid'; re text:=p_callback->>'RecordingSid';
  ca text:=p_callback->>'CallSid'; st text:=p_callback->>'RecordingStatus'; aid uuid;
BEGIN
  IF ac !~ '^AC[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$' OR ca !~ '^CA[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$'
    OR st NOT IN ('completed','absent') OR
    (st='completed' AND coalesce(re,'') !~ '^RE[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid recording callback' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_attempt_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO aid FROM telephony_call_attempts WHERE id=p_attempt_id
      AND (parent_call_sid=ca OR child_call_sid=ca);
    IF aid IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recording attempt mismatch' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO recording_ingestion(account_sid,recording_sid,callback_call_sid,recording_key,
    attempt_id,provider_status,recording_url,recording_source,recording_channels,recording_duration_seconds,
    provider_created_at,copy_status)
  VALUES(ac,re,ca,ac||'/'||coalesce(re,'absent:'||ca||':'||coalesce(aid::text,'')),aid,st,
    CASE WHEN re IS NOT NULL THEN 'https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/'||ac||'/Recordings/'||re END,
    left(p_callback->>'RecordingSource',64),nullif(p_callback->>'RecordingChannels','')::smallint,
    nullif(p_callback->>'RecordingDuration','')::integer,
    nullif(p_callback->>'RecordingStartTime','')::timestamptz,
    CASE WHEN st='absent' THEN 'absent' ELSE 'pending' END)
  ON CONFLICT(recording_key) DO UPDATE SET
    attempt_id=coalesce(recording_ingestion.attempt_id,EXCLUDED.attempt_id),
    provider_status=CASE WHEN recording_ingestion.provider_status='completed' THEN 'completed' ELSE EXCLUDED.provider_status END,
    recording_source=coalesce(EXCLUDED.recording_source,recording_ingestion.recording_source),
    recording_channels=coalesce(EXCLUDED.recording_channels,recording_ingestion.recording_channels),
    recording_duration_seconds=coalesce(EXCLUDED.recording_duration_seconds,recording_ingestion.recording_duration_seconds),
    provider_created_at=coalesce(EXCLUDED.provider_created_at,recording_ingestion.provider_created_at),
    copy_status=CASE WHEN recording_ingestion.copy_status='absent' AND EXCLUDED.provider_status='completed'
      THEN 'pending' ELSE recording_ingestion.copy_status END, updated_at=now()
  RETURNING id INTO rid;
  PERFORM resolve_recording_attribution(rid);
  RETURN rid;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_compliance_upload(p_provider text, p_id uuid, p_token uuid, p_success boolean, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_receipt text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE tab text; BEGIN
 tab:=CASE p_provider WHEN 'conversely' THEN 'conversely_submissions' WHEN 'ix' THEN 'ix_uploads' WHEN 'ghl' THEN 'ghl_enrollment_deliveries' ELSE NULL END;
 IF tab IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid provider'; END IF;
 EXECUTE format('UPDATE %I SET status=CASE WHEN $3 THEN ''uploaded'' WHEN attempts>=5 THEN ''failed'' ELSE ''pending'' END,
 last_error=CASE WHEN $3 THEN NULL ELSE $4 END,ix_receipt_id=$5,uploaded_at=CASE WHEN $3 THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
 next_attempt_at=now()+make_interval(secs=>60*power(2,attempts-1)::integer),lease_until=NULL,lease_token=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=$1 AND lease_token=$2 AND status=''uploading''',tab) USING p_id,p_token,p_success,p_error,p_receipt;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_inbound_call(p_call_sid text, p_status text, p_ended_at timestamp with time zone, p_duration integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_status IS NULL OR p_status NOT IN ('completed', 'answered', 'canceled', 'no-answer', 'busy', 'failed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported terminal call status';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.inbound_calls SET
    ended_at = coalesce(ended_at, p_ended_at),
    duration_seconds = coalesce(p_duration, duration_seconds),
    status = CASE
      WHEN answered_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed'
      WHEN status = 'voicemail' THEN 'voicemail'
      WHEN status IN ('canceled', 'no-answer', 'busy', 'failed') THEN status
      WHEN p_status IN ('canceled', 'no-answer', 'busy', 'failed') THEN p_status
      ELSE 'no-answer'
    END
  WHERE twilio_call_sid = p_call_sid;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_ix_upload(p_id uuid, p_token uuid, p_outcome text, p_error text, p_message text, p_receipt jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_outcome NOT IN ('uploaded','retry','failed','needs_attention','duplicate_on_sunfire') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid IX outcome'; END IF;
 UPDATE ix_uploads SET status=CASE WHEN p_outcome='retry' THEN CASE WHEN attempts>=5 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END ELSE p_outcome END,
 retryable=p_outcome='retry' AND attempts<5,last_error=CASE WHEN p_outcome='uploaded' THEN NULL ELSE p_error END,
 provider_message=nullif(left(p_message,500),''),
 ix_receipt_id=CASE WHEN p_outcome='uploaded' THEN p_receipt->>'callRecordingId' ELSE ix_receipt_id END,
 finalize_receipt=CASE WHEN p_outcome='uploaded' THEN p_receipt ELSE finalize_receipt END,
 finalized_at=CASE WHEN p_outcome='uploaded' THEN now() ELSE finalized_at END,
 uploaded_at=CASE WHEN p_outcome='uploaded' THEN now() ELSE uploaded_at END,
 next_attempt_at=now()+make_interval(secs=>60*power(2,attempts-1)::integer),lease_until=NULL,lease_token=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=p_id AND lease_token=p_token AND status='uploading' AND lease_until>=now();
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_post_call_request(p_session_id uuid, p_worker_id uuid, p_request_key text, p_result jsonb, p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM 1 FROM post_call_jobs WHERE session_id=p_session_id AND worker_id=p_worker_id FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Worker ownership mismatch'; END IF;
 UPDATE post_call_requests SET status=CASE WHEN p_error_code IS NULL THEN 'completed' ELSE 'failed' END,
 result=coalesce(p_result,'{}'),error_code=p_error_code,completed_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE session_id=p_session_id AND request_key=p_request_key AND status='running';
 UPDATE post_call_jobs SET result=result||coalesce(p_result,'{}'),
 error_code=coalesce((SELECT value->>'code' FROM jsonb_each(provider_errors) ORDER BY value->>'at' DESC LIMIT 1),p_error_code),
 status=CASE WHEN provider_errors<>'{}'::jsonb OR p_error_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'failed' ELSE status END,
 progress=CASE WHEN provider_errors<>'{}'::jsonb OR p_error_code IS NOT NULL THEN 'failed' ELSE 'saved' END,
 updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE session_id=p_session_id;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_available_seps_before_fema_078(input_zip text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  result JSONB;
  county_info JSONB;
  five_star JSONB;
  disasters JSONB;
  csnp JSONB;
  dsnp JSONB;
  dual_lis JSONB;
  isnp JSONB;
  terminations JSONB;
BEGIN
  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'county_fips', county_fips,
    'county_name', county_name,
    'state_code', state_code,
    'state_name', state_name,
    'residential_ratio', residential_ratio
  ) ORDER BY residential_ratio DESC NULLS LAST)
  INTO county_info
  FROM public.zip_county_crosswalk
  WHERE zip = input_zip;

  IF county_info IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'zip', input_zip,
      'error', 'ZIP code not found in crosswalk',
      'seps', '[]'::jsonb
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'sep_type', '5-Star Special Enrollment Period',
    'cfr_reference', '42 CFR Sec. 422.62(b)(15)',
    'available', COUNT(DISTINCT sr.contract_id) > 0,
    'period', 'Year-round (continuous)',
    'evidence', CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sr.contract_id) > 0 THEN COUNT(DISTINCT sr.contract_id)::TEXT || ' five-star rated plan(s) available'
      ELSE 'No five-star plans in this area'
    END,
    'plans', COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
      'contract_id', sr.contract_id,
      'plan_name', sr.plan_name,
      'organization', sr.organization_name,
      'stars', sr.overall_star_rating
    )) FILTER (WHERE sr.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  INTO five_star
  FROM public.zip_county_crosswalk zc
  LEFT JOIN public.star_ratings_by_county sr
    ON sr.county_fips = zc.county_fips
    AND sr.overall_star_rating = 5.0
    AND sr.plan_year = 2027
  WHERE zc.zip = input_zip;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'sep_type', 'Disaster / Emergency SEP',
    'cfr_reference', '42 CFR Sec. 422.62(b)(18)(ii); CMS HPMS memo',
    'available', COUNT(fd.id) > 0,
    'period', 'Duration of disaster declaration + 2 months',
    'evidence', CASE
      WHEN COUNT(fd.id) > 0 THEN COUNT(fd.id)::TEXT || ' active disaster declaration(s) identified'
      ELSE 'No active disaster declarations in this area'
    END,
    'disasters', COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
      'disaster_number', fd.disaster_number,
      'title', fd.declaration_title,
      'type', fd.incident_type,
      'declared', fd.declaration_date,
      'sep_ends', fd.sep_end_date
    )) FILTER (WHERE fd.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  INTO disasters
  FROM public.zip_county_crosswalk zc
  LEFT JOIN public.fema_disasters fd
    ON fd.county_fips = zc.county_fips
    AND fd.ia_designated = TRUE
    AND fd.sep_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE
  WHERE zc.zip = input_zip;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'sep_type', 'Chronic Condition SNP (C-SNP) SEP',
    'cfr_reference', '42 CFR Sec. 422.62(b)(4)',
    'available', COUNT(sp.id) > 0,
    'period', 'Year-round for qualifying chronic conditions',
    'evidence', CASE
      WHEN COUNT(sp.id) > 0 THEN COUNT(sp.id)::TEXT || ' C-SNP plan(s) available'
      ELSE 'No C-SNP plans in this area'
    END,
    'plan_count', COUNT(sp.id),
    'plans', COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
      'contract_id', sp.contract_id,
      'plan_id', sp.plan_id,
      'plan_name', sp.plan_name,
      'organization', sp.organization_name,
      'chronic_conditions', sp.chronic_conditions
    )) FILTER (WHERE sp.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  INTO csnp
  FROM public.zip_county_crosswalk zc
  LEFT JOIN public.snp_plans_by_county sp
    ON sp.county_fips = zc.county_fips
    AND sp.snp_type = 'C-SNP'
    AND sp.plan_year = 2027
  WHERE zc.zip = input_zip;

  -- A ZIP is not evidence of Medicaid/LIS, drug-management status or monthly use.
  dual_lis := jsonb_build_object(
    'sep_type', 'Dual / LIS monthly PDP SEP',
    'cfr_reference', '42 CFR 423.38(c)(4)',
    'available', NULL, 'area_based', false,
    'eligibility_status', 'verification_required',
    'eligible_products', jsonb_build_array('PDP'),
    'period', 'Once per calendar month; effective first day of next month',
    'evidence', 'Verify full/partial Medicaid or Extra Help, monthly election use, and absence of Part D at-risk/potential-at-risk designation. Standalone PDP only, including leaving MA-PD for Original Medicare plus PDP; no MA-to-MA switch.',
    'plans', '[]'::jsonb
  );

  -- Integration is plan-specific, not inferred from being any D-SNP or from
  -- another plan's status. This is area availability, never member eligibility.
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'sep_type', 'Integrated-care monthly D-SNP SEP',
    'cfr_reference', '42 CFR 423.38(c)(35); aligned enrollment as defined in 42 CFR 422.2',
    'available', COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id)>0, 'area_based', true,
    'eligibility_status', 'verification_required',
    'eligible_products', jsonb_build_array('D-SNP'),
    'period', 'Once per calendar month; effective first day of next month',
    'evidence', CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id)>0
      THEN 'Eligible integrated plans found. Verify full-benefit Medicaid (QMB+, SLMB+, FBDE), plan/service-area eligibility, monthly use, and aligned Medicaid MCO enrollment. Remaining in Medicaid FFS or an unaligned MCO does not qualify; partial dual or LIS-only status does not qualify.'
      ELSE 'No verified FIDE/HIDE/AIP D-SNP found in current county data. Missing integration evidence does not establish eligibility. Full-benefit status and aligned Medicaid MCO enrollment are required.' END,
    'plan_count', COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id),
    'plans', COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
      'contract_id', sp.contract_id, 'plan_id', sp.plan_id,
      'plan_name', sp.plan_name, 'organization', sp.carrier,
      'integration_status', sp.dsnp_integration_status,
      'aip_identifier', sp.dsnp_aip_identifier
    )) FILTER (WHERE sp.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO dsnp
  FROM public.zip_county_crosswalk zc
  LEFT JOIN public.cms_plans_py2027 sp ON sp.county_fips=zc.county_fips
    AND sp.state_code=zc.state_code AND sp.plan_year=2027
    AND sp.snp_type='Dual-Eligible'
    AND (upper(trim(coalesce(sp.dsnp_integration_status,''))) IN ('FIDE','HIDE','FIDE SNP','HIDE SNP','FIDE-SNP','HIDE-SNP')
      OR lower(trim(coalesce(sp.dsnp_aip_identifier,''))) IN ('yes','y','1','true','aip'))
  WHERE zc.zip=input_zip;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'sep_type', 'Institutional SNP (I-SNP) SEP',
    'cfr_reference', '42 CFR Sec. 422.62(b)(4)',
    'available', COUNT(sp.id) > 0,
    'period', 'Year-round for institutionalized individuals',
    'evidence', CASE
      WHEN COUNT(sp.id) > 0 THEN COUNT(sp.id)::TEXT || ' I-SNP plan(s) available'
      ELSE 'No I-SNP plans in this area'
    END,
    'plan_count', COUNT(sp.id),
    'plans', COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
      'contract_id', sp.contract_id,
      'plan_id', sp.plan_id,
      'plan_name', sp.plan_name,
      'organization', sp.organization_name,
      'enrollment_count', sp.enrollment_count
    )) FILTER (WHERE sp.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  INTO isnp
  FROM public.zip_county_crosswalk zc
  LEFT JOIN public.snp_plans_by_county sp
    ON sp.county_fips = zc.county_fips
    AND sp.snp_type = 'I-SNP'
    AND sp.plan_year = 2027
  WHERE zc.zip = input_zip;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'sep_type', 'Involuntary Disenrollment / Plan Termination SEP',
    'cfr_reference', '42 CFR Sec. 422.62(b)(5)',
    'available', COUNT(pt.id) > 0,
    'period', '2 months from plan termination effective date',
    'evidence', CASE
      WHEN COUNT(pt.id) > 0 THEN 'Carrier exits detected in this market. Displaced members are SEP-eligible.'
      ELSE 'No plan terminations detected in this area'
    END,
    'terminated_plans', COALESCE(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
      'old_plan', pt.old_plan_name,
      'old_org', pt.old_organization_name,
      'type', pt.termination_type,
      'effective', pt.effective_date,
      'replacement_plan', pt.new_plan_name
    )) FILTER (WHERE pt.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  INTO terminations
  FROM public.zip_county_crosswalk zc
  LEFT JOIN public.plan_terminations pt
    ON pt.county_fips = zc.county_fips
    AND pt.plan_year = 2027
    AND pt.termination_type IN ('terminated', 'service_area_reduction')
    AND pt.county_mapping_status = 'affected_service_area'
    AND (pt.effective_date IS NULL OR pt.effective_date + INTERVAL '2 months' >= CURRENT_DATE)
  WHERE zc.zip = input_zip;

  result := jsonb_build_object(
    'zip', input_zip,
    'counties', county_info,
    'queried_at', NOW(),
    'seps', jsonb_build_array(
      five_star,
      disasters,
      csnp,
      dual_lis,
      dsnp,
      isnp,
      terminations
    )
  );

  RETURN result;
END;
$function$

routines.result: TABLE(plan_id bigint, content text, similarity double precision)
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_cms_plans_py2027(query_embedding vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(plan_id bigint, content text, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT e.plan_id, e.content, 1 - (e.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM public.cms_plan_embeddings_py2027 e
  JOIN public.cms_plans_py2027 p ON p.id = e.plan_id
  WHERE e.plan_year = 2027 AND p.plan_year = 2027
  ORDER BY e.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(match_count, 1), 50);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_phone_e164(raw text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN raw IS NULL OR btrim(raw) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN regexp_replace(raw, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') ~ '^1[0-9]{10}$'
      THEN '+' || regexp_replace(raw, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
    WHEN regexp_replace(raw, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') ~ '^[0-9]{10}$'
      THEN '+1' || regexp_replace(raw, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
    WHEN btrim(raw) ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$' THEN btrim(raw)
    ELSE NULL
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.paragon_agent_tier(p_agent_id text, p_state text, p_source_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH cfg AS (SELECT * FROM vendor_routing_config WHERE source_id=p_source_id),
  matrix AS (SELECT e.* FROM vendor_agent_state_eligibility e JOIN tenant_agents a ON a.id=e.agent_id
    JOIN cfg ON cfg.source_id=e.source_id AND cfg.plan_year=e.plan_year
    WHERE e.state=p_state AND a.agent_slug=p_agent_id AND a.is_active),
  missing AS (SELECT c.carrier FROM cfg CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(cfg.required_carriers) c(carrier)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matrix m WHERE CASE c.carrier
      WHEN 'aetna' THEN m.aetna WHEN 'humana' THEN m.humana WHEN 'uhc' THEN m.uhc
      WHEN 'wellcare' THEN m.wellcare WHEN 'devoted' THEN m.devoted
      WHEN 'healthspring' THEN m.healthspring ELSE false END))
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cfg) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM matrix) THEN 'ineligible'
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM missing m CROSS JOIN cfg WHERE m.carrier=ANY(cfg.critical_carriers)) THEN 'ineligible'
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM missing) THEN 'partial' ELSE 'full' END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.paragon_report_totals(p_source uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY d.day),'[]') FROM (
 SELECT (f.received_at AT TIME ZONE public.deployment_timezone())::date AS day,
 count(*) AS calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_billable) AS billable,coalesce(sum(amount_due),0) AS amount_due,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE duplicate_flag) AS duplicate_calls,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE billing_dispute) AS disputed_calls
 FROM paragon_billing_facts f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inbound_calls ti JOIN call_records tc ON tc.id=ti.call_record_id AND tc.tenant_id=ti.tenant_id WHERE ti.id=f.inbound_call_id AND ti.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND tc.is_test_enrollment) AND source_id=p_source AND received_at>=p_start AND received_at<p_end
 GROUP BY (f.received_at AT TIME ZONE public.deployment_timezone())::date
 ) d;
$function$

routines.name: paragon_vendor_report
routines.arguments: p_source_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone
routines.result: TABLE(call_id text, received_at timestamp with time zone, caller_phone text, caller_state text, duration_seconds integer, billable text, non_billable_reason text, disposition_category text, serviceability text)
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.paragon_vendor_report(p_source_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(call_id text, received_at timestamp with time zone, caller_phone text, caller_state text, duration_seconds integer, billable text, non_billable_reason text, disposition_category text, serviceability text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT f.vendor_call_id AS call_id,coalesce(f.arrived_at,i.created_at) AS received_at,
    f.caller_phone,coalesce(i.confirmed_state,f.caller_state),f.billable_seconds AS duration_seconds,
    CASE WHEN f.is_billable THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS billable,
    CASE WHEN f.billable_seconds IS NULL THEN 'billing_unverified'
      WHEN f.is_billable THEN NULL WHEN f.wrong_state THEN 'wrong_state'
      WHEN i.status='rejected' THEN 'rejected' WHEN i.status='failed' THEN 'failed'
      ELSE 'under_90_seconds' END AS non_billable_reason,
    CASE
      WHEN r.call_outcome='sale_ancillary' THEN 'sale'
      WHEN coalesce(r.vendor_disposition,r.call_outcome,i.status) IN
        ('enrolled','enrolled_pending_verification','partial_enrollment','not_enrolled','incomplete',
         'callback_scheduled','interested_needs_info','spouse_poa_callback','transferred',
         'application_in_progress','not_interested','not_qualified','already_enrolled_elsewhere',
         'customer_hung_up','do_not_call','requested_removal','no_answer','voicemail_left',
         'wrong_number','bad_lead_data','language_barrier','third_party_needed','hostile_caller',
         'suspected_fraud','dropped_call','test_call','duplicate_lead','rejected','failed',
         'completed','accepted','declined','voicemail','wrong_state')
      THEN coalesce(r.vendor_disposition,r.call_outcome,i.status)
      ELSE 'other' END AS disposition_category,
    CASE i.paragon_serviceability WHEN 'not_serviceable' THEN 'Out of state: not serviceable' WHEN 'callback' THEN 'Paragon callback: out-of-state' ELSE '' END AS serviceability
  FROM paragon_billing_facts f
  LEFT JOIN inbound_calls i ON i.id=f.inbound_call_id AND i.tenant_id=f.tenant_id
  LEFT JOIN call_records r ON r.id=i.call_record_id AND r.tenant_id=f.tenant_id
  WHERE NOT coalesce(r.is_test_enrollment,false) AND f.source_id=p_source_id AND coalesce(f.arrived_at,i.created_at)>=p_start
    AND coalesce(f.arrived_at,i.created_at)<p_end
  ORDER BY coalesce(f.arrived_at,i.created_at) DESC,f.parent_call_sid DESC;
$function$

routines.name: paragon_weekly_reconciliation
routines.arguments: p_tenant_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_rate numeric
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.paragon_weekly_reconciliation(p_tenant_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_rate numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_rate IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM paragon_billing_facts f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inbound_calls ti JOIN call_records tc ON tc.id=ti.call_record_id AND tc.tenant_id=ti.tenant_id WHERE ti.id=f.inbound_call_id AND ti.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND tc.is_test_enrollment) AND tenant_id=p_tenant_id
 AND received_at>=p_start AND received_at<p_end AND rate_per_call<>p_rate) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Use persisted Paragon rates'; END IF;
 WITH calls AS (SELECT * FROM paragon_billing_facts f WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inbound_calls ti JOIN call_records tc ON tc.id=ti.call_record_id AND tc.tenant_id=ti.tenant_id WHERE ti.id=f.inbound_call_id AND ti.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND tc.is_test_enrollment) AND tenant_id=p_tenant_id AND received_at>=p_start AND received_at<p_end),
 totals AS (SELECT count(*) AS total_calls,count(*) FILTER(WHERE is_billable) AS billable_calls,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE app_written) AS apps_written,coalesce(sum(amount_due),0) AS expected_invoice,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE billable_seconds IS NULL) AS unverified_calls,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE duplicate_flag) AS duplicate_calls FROM calls),
 states AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(state,cost),'{}') AS costs FROM
 (SELECT state,CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE app_written)>0
 THEN round(sum(amount_due)/count(*) FILTER(WHERE app_written),2) END AS cost FROM calls GROUP BY state) s),
 disputes AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('call_id',vendor_call_id,'twilio_call_sid',parent_call_sid,
 'state',state,'zip',confirmed_zip,'billable_seconds',billable_seconds,'wrong_state',wrong_state,
 'billing_dispute',billing_dispute,'amount_due',amount_due,
 'duplicate_flag',duplicate_flag,'duplicate_prior_call_id',duplicate_prior_call_id)) FILTER(WHERE wrong_state),'[]') AS items,
 coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('inbound_call_id',inbound_call_id,'call_id',vendor_call_id,
 'twilio_call_sid',parent_call_sid,'duplicate_flag',duplicate_flag,
 'duplicate_prior_call_id',duplicate_prior_call_id,'billing_dispute',billing_dispute,
 'billable_seconds',billable_seconds,'amount_due',amount_due)) FILTER(WHERE duplicate_flag),'[]') AS duplicates FROM calls)
 SELECT to_jsonb(totals)||jsonb_build_object('cost_per_app_by_state',states.costs,'wrong_state_calls',disputes.items,'duplicate_calls_detail',disputes.duplicates)
 INTO result FROM totals,states,disputes;
 RETURN result;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ping_agent_tier(p_agent_id text, p_state text, p_campaign_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH cfg AS (SELECT * FROM ping_campaigns WHERE id=p_campaign_id),
  matrix AS (SELECT e.carrier,e.enabled FROM agent_campaign_carriers e
    JOIN tenant_agents a ON a.id=e.agent_id
    JOIN cfg ON cfg.id=e.campaign_id AND cfg.plan_year=e.plan_year AND cfg.tenant_id=e.tenant_id
    WHERE e.state=p_state AND a.agent_slug=p_agent_id AND a.is_active AND a.tenant_id=cfg.tenant_id),
  missing AS (SELECT c.carrier FROM cfg CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(cfg.required_carriers) c(carrier)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matrix m WHERE m.enabled AND m.carrier=c.carrier))
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cfg) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM matrix) THEN 'ineligible'
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM missing m CROSS JOIN cfg WHERE m.carrier=ANY(cfg.critical_carriers)) THEN 'ineligible'
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM missing) THEN 'partial' ELSE 'full' END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ping_existing_client(p_tenant uuid, p_phone text)
 RETURNS TABLE(contact_id uuid, owner_agent_id text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE phone_key text:=public.duplicate_phone_key(p_phone); c record; owner text;
BEGIN
 IF p_tenant IS NULL OR phone_key IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT x.id,x.assigned_agent_id INTO c FROM contacts x
  WHERE x.tenant_id=p_tenant AND x.phone=phone_key AND public.duplicate_phone_key(x.phone)=phone_key
    AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM call_records r WHERE r.tenant_id=p_tenant AND r.contact_id=x.id
          AND r.call_outcome IN ('enrolled','enrolled_pending_verification') AND r.is_test_enrollment IS NOT TRUE)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM opportunities o WHERE o.tenant_id=p_tenant AND o.contact_id=x.id
          AND o.status='won' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL))
  ORDER BY x.created_at,x.id LIMIT 1;
 IF c.id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT s.slug INTO owner FROM (
   SELECT ta.agent_slug AS slug,coalesce(r.call_start,r.created_at) AS sold_at FROM call_records r
    JOIN enrolled_agents e ON e.id=r.agent_id AND e.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
    JOIN tenant_agents ta ON ta.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND ta.clerk_user_id=e.clerk_user_id
    WHERE r.tenant_id=p_tenant AND r.contact_id=c.id
      AND r.call_outcome IN ('enrolled','enrolled_pending_verification') AND r.is_test_enrollment IS NOT TRUE
   UNION ALL
   SELECT ta.agent_slug,o.stage_entered_at FROM opportunities o
    JOIN tenant_agents ta ON ta.id=o.assigned_agent_id AND ta.tenant_id=o.tenant_id
    WHERE o.tenant_id=p_tenant AND o.contact_id=c.id AND o.status='won' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
 ) s WHERE nullif(trim(s.slug),'') IS NOT NULL
 ORDER BY s.sold_at DESC NULLS LAST,s.slug LIMIT 1;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT c.id,coalesce(owner,nullif(trim(c.assigned_agent_id),''));
END $function$

DECLARE phone_key text:=public.duplicate_phone_key(p_phone);
BEGIN
 IF p_tenant IS NULL OR phone_key IS NULL OR p_since IS NULL OR p_until IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inbound_calls i
  WHERE i.tenant_id=p_tenant AND public.duplicate_phone_key(i.from_number)=phone_key
    AND i.created_at>p_since AND i.created_at<=p_until
    AND ((i.source_kind='publisher' AND (p_source IS NULL OR i.lead_source_id=p_source))
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ping_decisions d WHERE d.matched_call_sid=i.twilio_call_sid
        AND d.tenant_id=p_tenant AND d.engine IN ('generic','exchange')
        AND (p_source IS NULL OR d.source_id=p_source))));

routines.name: ping_resolve_arrival
routines.arguments: p_phone text, p_call_id text, p_call_sid text, p_to_number text, p_arrived_at timestamp with time zone
routines.result: TABLE(matched boolean, available boolean, caller_state text, vendor_call_id text, reason text, decision_id uuid, campaign_id uuid, tenant_id uuid, source_id uuid)
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ping_resolve_arrival(p_phone text, p_call_id text, p_call_sid text, p_to_number text, p_arrived_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(matched boolean, available boolean, caller_state text, vendor_call_id text, reason text, decision_id uuid, campaign_id uuid, tenant_id uuid, source_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE d ping_decisions; exchange_on boolean;
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.deployment_feature_enabled('PING_PLATFORM_ENABLED') OR nullif(p_to_number,'') IS NULL
 OR p_arrived_at IS NULL OR (nullif(p_phone,'') IS NULL AND nullif(p_call_id,'') IS NULL) THEN
  RETURN QUERY SELECT false,NULL::boolean,NULL::text,NULL::text,NULL::text,NULL::uuid,NULL::uuid,NULL::uuid,NULL::uuid;
  RETURN;
 END IF;
 exchange_on:=public.deployment_feature_enabled('PING_EXCHANGE_ENABLED');
 SELECT x.* INTO d FROM ping_decisions x
  JOIN ping_campaigns c ON c.id=x.campaign_id AND c.tenant_id=x.tenant_id
  JOIN lead_sources s ON s.id=x.source_id
  WHERE c.engine_mode='generic' AND s.active
    AND ((x.engine='generic' AND c.source_id=x.source_id AND s.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND s.twilio_number=p_to_number)
      OR (x.engine='exchange' AND exchange_on AND c.transfer_number=p_to_number))
    AND x.received_at>=p_arrived_at-interval '5 minutes' AND x.received_at<=p_arrived_at
    AND (x.matched_call_sid IS NULL OR x.matched_call_sid=p_call_sid)
    AND ((nullif(p_call_id,'') IS NOT NULL AND x.vendor_call_id=p_call_id)
      OR (nullif(p_phone,'') IS NOT NULL AND x.caller_phone=p_phone
        AND (nullif(p_call_id,'') IS NULL OR x.vendor_call_id IS NULL)))
  ORDER BY x.available DESC,CASE WHEN nullif(p_call_id,'') IS NOT NULL AND x.vendor_call_id=p_call_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    x.received_at DESC,x.id
  LIMIT 1;
 IF d.id IS NULL THEN
  RETURN QUERY SELECT false,NULL::boolean,NULL::text,NULL::text,NULL::text,NULL::uuid,NULL::uuid,NULL::uuid,NULL::uuid;
 ELSE
  RETURN QUERY SELECT true,d.available,d.caller_state,d.vendor_call_id,d.reason,d.id,d.campaign_id,d.tenant_id,d.source_id;
 END IF;
END; $function$

routines.name: ping_scorecard_rows
routines.arguments: p_tenant uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_group text[], p_operator boolean
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ping_scorecard_rows(p_tenant uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_group text[], p_operator boolean)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE g text[]:=coalesce(p_group,'{}'::text[]);
  allowed text[]:=ARRAY['source','sub_id','campaign','state','day'];
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.deployment_feature_enabled('PING_SCORECARD_ENABLED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ping scorecard disabled'; END IF;
 IF p_operator THEN allowed:=allowed||ARRAY['buyer_tenant'];
 ELSIF p_tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Scorecard tenant required'; END IF;
 IF p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR p_to<=p_from THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid scorecard window'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(g) x WHERE x IS NULL OR NOT x=ANY(allowed)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unknown scorecard group'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH base AS (
   SELECT d.id,d.tenant_id,d.source_id,d.campaign_id,d.received_at,d.caller_state,d.publisher_sub_id,
     d.available,d.reason,d.rule_trace,d.engine,d.matched_call_sid
   FROM ping_decisions d
   WHERE (p_operator AND p_tenant IS NULL OR d.tenant_id=p_tenant)
     AND d.received_at>=p_from AND d.received_at<p_to
     AND d.engine IN ('generic','exchange_eval','exchange')
 ), zones AS (
   SELECT t.tenant_id,public.ping_tenant_zone(t.tenant_id) AS zone FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM base) t
 ), facts AS (
   SELECT
     CASE WHEN 'buyer_tenant'=ANY(g) THEN b.tenant_id END AS k_tenant,
     CASE WHEN 'source'=ANY(g) THEN b.source_id END AS k_source,
     CASE WHEN 'sub_id'=ANY(g) THEN b.publisher_sub_id END AS k_sub,
     CASE WHEN 'campaign'=ANY(g) THEN b.campaign_id END AS k_campaign,
     CASE WHEN 'state'=ANY(g) THEN b.caller_state END AS k_state,
     CASE WHEN 'day'=ANY(g) THEN (b.received_at AT TIME ZONE z.zone)::date END AS k_day,
     b.engine IN ('generic','exchange_eval') AS is_ping,
     b.available,b.reason,
     b.engine='exchange' AND b.available AND NOT b.rule_trace @> '[{"rule":"commitment_replay"}]'::jsonb AS is_win,
     b.engine IN ('generic','exchange_eval')
       AND b.rule_trace @> '[{"rule":"existing_client_retention","result":"hit"}]'::jsonb AS is_retention,
     b.engine IN ('generic','exchange') AND b.matched_call_sid IS NOT NULL AS is_arrival,
     i.answered_agent_id IS NOT NULL AS is_connect,
     coalesce(bill.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND bill.billable_seconds>=bill.billable_threshold_seconds,false) AS is_billable,
     coalesce(r.app_written,false) AS is_app,
     coalesce(r.call_outcome='enrolled' AND r.is_test_enrollment IS NOT TRUE,false) AS is_enrolled,
     bill.rate,rt.open_returns,rt.credited_returns
   FROM base b JOIN zones z ON z.tenant_id=b.tenant_id
   LEFT JOIN ping_call_billing bill ON b.engine IN ('generic','exchange') AND b.matched_call_sid IS NOT NULL
     AND bill.decision_id=b.id AND bill.tenant_id=b.tenant_id
   LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.answered_agent_id,x.call_record_id FROM inbound_calls x
     WHERE b.engine IN ('generic','exchange') AND b.matched_call_sid IS NOT NULL
       AND x.twilio_call_sid=b.matched_call_sid AND x.tenant_id=b.tenant_id
     ORDER BY x.created_at,x.id LIMIT 1) i ON true
   LEFT JOIN call_records r ON r.id=i.call_record_id AND r.tenant_id=b.tenant_id
   LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status IN ('open','submitted')) AS open_returns,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status='credited') AS credited_returns
     FROM ping_returns x WHERE x.billing_parent_call_sid=bill.parent_call_sid AND x.tenant_id=b.tenant_id) rt ON true
 ), agg AS (
   SELECT k_tenant,k_source,k_sub,k_campaign,k_state,k_day,
     count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_ping) AS pings,
     count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_ping AND available) AS accepts,
     count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_win) AS wins,
     count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_arrival) AS arrivals,
     count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_arrival AND is_connect) AS connects,
     count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_arrival AND is_billable) AS billable,
     coalesce(sum(rate) FILTER (WHERE is_arrival AND is_billable),0)::numeric AS cost,
     count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_arrival AND is_app) AS apps,
     count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_arrival AND is_enrolled) AS enrollments,
     coalesce(sum(open_returns) FILTER (WHERE is_arrival),0)::bigint AS returns_open,
     coalesce(sum(credited_returns) FILTER (WHERE is_arrival),0)::bigint AS returns_credited,
     count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_retention) AS retention_hits
   FROM facts GROUP BY k_tenant,k_source,k_sub,k_campaign,k_state,k_day
 ), rej AS (
   SELECT k_tenant,k_source,k_sub,k_campaign,k_state,k_day,jsonb_object_agg(reason,n) AS obj
   FROM (SELECT k_tenant,k_source,k_sub,k_campaign,k_state,k_day,reason,count(*) AS n FROM facts
     WHERE is_ping AND NOT available GROUP BY k_tenant,k_source,k_sub,k_campaign,k_state,k_day,reason) x
   GROUP BY k_tenant,k_source,k_sub,k_campaign,k_state,k_day
 )
 SELECT
   CASE WHEN 'buyer_tenant'=ANY(g) THEN jsonb_build_object('buyer_tenant',a.k_tenant) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
   ||CASE WHEN 'source'=ANY(g) THEN jsonb_build_object('source',a.k_source) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
   ||CASE WHEN 'sub_id'=ANY(g) THEN jsonb_build_object('sub_id',a.k_sub) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
   ||CASE WHEN 'campaign'=ANY(g) THEN jsonb_build_object('campaign',a.k_campaign) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
   ||CASE WHEN 'state'=ANY(g) THEN jsonb_build_object('state',a.k_state) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
   ||CASE WHEN 'day'=ANY(g) THEN jsonb_build_object('day',a.k_day) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
   ||jsonb_build_object('pings',a.pings,'accepts',a.accepts,
     'accept_rate',CASE WHEN a.pings>0 THEN round(a.accepts::numeric/a.pings,4) END,
     'rejects_by_reason',coalesce(rj.obj,'{}'::jsonb),'exchange_wins',a.wins,
     'arrivals',a.arrivals,'connects',a.connects,'billable_calls',a.billable,'cost',a.cost,
     'apps',a.apps,'enrollments',a.enrollments,
     'cost_per_app',CASE WHEN a.apps>0 THEN round(a.cost/a.apps,2) END,
     'cost_per_enrollment',CASE WHEN a.enrollments>0 THEN round(a.cost/a.enrollments,2) END,
     'returns_open',a.returns_open,'returns_credited',a.returns_credited,'retention_hits',a.retention_hits)
 FROM agg a LEFT JOIN rej rj ON rj.k_tenant IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.k_tenant AND rj.k_source IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.k_source
   AND rj.k_sub IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.k_sub AND rj.k_campaign IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.k_campaign
   AND rj.k_state IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.k_state AND rj.k_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.k_day
 ORDER BY a.k_tenant::text,a.k_source::text,a.k_sub,a.k_campaign::text,a.k_state,a.k_day;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_invoice_lines(p_tenant uuid, p_month date)
 RETURNS TABLE(line_no integer, kind text, description text, quantity numeric, included_quantity numeric, charged_quantity numeric, amount numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
DECLARE month_start date;
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.deployment_feature_enabled('PING_SCORECARD_ENABLED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ping scorecard disabled'; END IF;
 IF p_tenant IS NULL OR p_month IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid usage period'; END IF;
 month_start:=date_trunc('month',p_month)::date;
 RETURN QUERY
 SELECT k.n,k.kind,k.description,sum(e.quantity),
   coalesce(sum(e.quantity) FILTER (WHERE e.unit_price=0),0),
   coalesce(sum(e.quantity) FILTER (WHERE e.unit_price>0),0),
   round(sum(e.quantity*e.unit_price),2)
 FROM (VALUES (1,'ping','Pings evaluated'),(2,'routed_call','Routed calls'),
   (3,'screener_minute','Screener minutes'),(4,'screened_qualified','Screened qualified results')) k(n,kind,description)
 JOIN platform_usage_events e ON e.kind=k.kind AND e.tenant_id=p_tenant
   AND e.occurred_at>=month_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
   AND e.occurred_at<(month_start+interval '1 month')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
 GROUP BY k.n,k.kind,k.description
 ORDER BY k.n;
END $function$
