CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_usage_summary(p_tenant uuid, p_month date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE month_start date; result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF NOT public.deployment_feature_enabled('PING_SCORECARD_ENABLED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ping scorecard disabled'; END IF;
 IF p_tenant IS NULL OR p_month IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid usage period'; END IF;
 month_start:=date_trunc('month',p_month)::date;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('tenant_id',p_tenant,'month',month_start,
   'period_start',month_start::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
   'period_end',(month_start+interval '1 month')::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
   'by_kind',coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(l.kind,jsonb_build_object('quantity',l.quantity,'amount',l.amount))
     FILTER (WHERE l.kind IS NOT NULL),'{}'::jsonb),
   'pings',coalesce(sum(l.quantity) FILTER (WHERE l.kind='ping'),0),
   'pings_inside_allowance',coalesce(sum(l.included_quantity) FILTER (WHERE l.kind='ping'),0),
   'overage_pings',coalesce(sum(l.charged_quantity) FILTER (WHERE l.kind='ping'),0),
   'overage_amount',coalesce(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.kind='ping'),0),
   'routed_calls',coalesce(sum(l.quantity) FILTER (WHERE l.kind='routed_call'),0),
   'routed_calls_amount',coalesce(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.kind='routed_call'),0),
   'screener_minutes',coalesce(sum(l.quantity) FILTER (WHERE l.kind='screener_minute'),0),
   'screener_minutes_amount',coalesce(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.kind='screener_minute'),0),
   'screened_qualified',coalesce(sum(l.quantity) FILTER (WHERE l.kind='screened_qualified'),0),
   'screened_qualified_amount',coalesce(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.kind='screened_qualified'),0),
   'screener_amount',coalesce(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.kind IN ('screener_minute','screened_qualified')),0),
   'total',coalesce(sum(l.amount),0))
 INTO result FROM public.platform_invoice_lines(p_tenant,month_start) l;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

routines.name: private_search_transcript_chunks
routines.arguments: query_embedding vector, match_count integer, filter_product_line text, filter_carrier text, filter_disposition text, filter_topics text[], similarity_threshold double precision
routines.result: TABLE(chunk_id uuid, transcript_id uuid, chunk_text text, speaker text, topics text[], similarity double precision, agent_name text, call_date timestamp with time zone, product_line text, carrier text, disposition text, compliance_passed boolean)
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.private_search_transcript_chunks(query_embedding vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 5, filter_product_line text DEFAULT NULL::text, filter_carrier text DEFAULT NULL::text, filter_disposition text DEFAULT NULL::text, filter_topics text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[], similarity_threshold double precision DEFAULT 0.7)
 RETURNS TABLE(chunk_id uuid, transcript_id uuid, chunk_text text, speaker text, topics text[], similarity double precision, agent_name text, call_date timestamp with time zone, product_line text, carrier text, disposition text, compliance_passed boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  select
    tc.id as chunk_id,
    tc.transcript_id,
    tc.chunk_text,
    tc.speaker,
    tc.topics,
    1 - (tc.embedding <=> query_embedding) as similarity,
    a.name as agent_name,
    ct.call_date,
    ct.product_line,
    ct.carrier,
    ct.disposition,
    ct.compliance_passed
  from public.transcript_chunks tc
  join public.call_transcripts ct on tc.transcript_id = ct.id
  join public.agents a on ct.agent_id = a.id
  where
    1 - (tc.embedding <=> query_embedding) > similarity_threshold
    and (filter_product_line is null or ct.product_line = filter_product_line)
    and (filter_carrier is null or ct.carrier = filter_carrier)
    and (filter_disposition is null or ct.disposition = filter_disposition)
    and (filter_topics is null or tc.topics && filter_topics) -- array overlap
    and ct.phi_scrubbed = true AND public.deployment_row_visible('call_transcripts',to_jsonb(ct))  -- safety: only return scrubbed transcripts
  order by tc.embedding <=> query_embedding
  limit match_count;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reconcile_paragon_serviceability(p_call uuid, p_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE c public.inbound_calls; task public.paragon_callback_tasks; owner_slug text; tier text; classification text;
BEGIN
 SELECT i.* INTO c FROM inbound_calls i JOIN lead_sources s ON s.id=i.lead_source_id AND s.tenant_id=i.tenant_id
 WHERE i.id=p_call AND i.tenant_id=p_tenant AND s.name=public.bootstrap_vendor_source_name() AND s.type='publisher' FOR UPDATE OF i;
 IF c.id IS NULL OR c.confirmed_state IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Confirmed Paragon call required'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO task FROM paragon_callback_tasks WHERE inbound_call_id=c.id AND tenant_id=c.tenant_id FOR UPDATE;
 tier:=paragon_agent_tier(c.routed_agent_id,c.confirmed_state,c.lead_source_id);
 IF tier IN ('full','partial') THEN
  classification:='in_state';
 ELSE
  -- Retain an eligible owner on retries; otherwise distribute to the least
  -- recently assigned eligible teammate. There is deliberately no NPN fallback.
  SELECT a.agent_slug INTO owner_slug FROM tenant_agents a
  LEFT JOIN agent_availability av ON av.agent_id=a.agent_slug
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT max(t.created_at) assigned_at FROM paragon_callback_tasks t
   WHERE t.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND t.assigned_agent_id=a.agent_slug) history ON true
  WHERE a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND a.is_active AND a.agent_slug IS NOT NULL
   AND a.agent_slug IS DISTINCT FROM c.routed_agent_id
   AND paragon_agent_tier(a.agent_slug,c.confirmed_state,c.lead_source_id) IN ('full','partial')
  ORDER BY (a.agent_slug=task.assigned_agent_id) DESC NULLS LAST,history.assigned_at NULLS FIRST,av.last_assigned_at NULLS FIRST,a.agent_slug
  LIMIT 1;
  classification:=CASE WHEN owner_slug IS NULL THEN 'not_serviceable' ELSE 'callback' END;
 END IF;
 UPDATE inbound_calls SET wrong_state=classification<>'in_state',paragon_serviceability=classification,
  return_reason=CASE classification WHEN 'not_serviceable' THEN 'out_of_state_not_serviceable' WHEN 'callback' THEN 'wrong_state' ELSE NULL END
 WHERE id=c.id AND tenant_id=c.tenant_id;
 IF classification='callback' THEN
  INSERT INTO paragon_callback_tasks(inbound_call_id,tenant_id,assigned_agent_id,caller_state,confirmed_zip,reason,status)
  VALUES(c.id,c.tenant_id,owner_slug,c.confirmed_state,c.confirmed_zip,'wrong_state','open')
  ON CONFLICT(inbound_call_id) DO UPDATE SET assigned_agent_id=excluded.assigned_agent_id,
   caller_state=excluded.caller_state,confirmed_zip=excluded.confirmed_zip,reason='wrong_state',
   status=CASE WHEN paragon_callback_tasks.status='completed' AND paragon_callback_tasks.assigned_agent_id=excluded.assigned_agent_id
     AND paragon_callback_tasks.caller_state=excluded.caller_state THEN 'completed' ELSE 'open' END,
   closed_at=CASE WHEN paragon_callback_tasks.status='completed' AND paragon_callback_tasks.assigned_agent_id=excluded.assigned_agent_id
     AND paragon_callback_tasks.caller_state=excluded.caller_state THEN paragon_callback_tasks.closed_at ELSE NULL END;
 ELSE
  UPDATE paragon_callback_tasks SET status='cancelled',closed_at=now(),
   reason=CASE classification WHEN 'not_serviceable' THEN 'out_of_state_not_serviceable' ELSE 'state_corrected' END
  WHERE inbound_call_id=c.id AND tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND status='open';
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('confirmed',true,'zip',c.confirmed_zip,'state',c.confirmed_state,'tier',tier,
  'wrong_state',classification<>'in_state','callback_agent_id',owner_slug,'serviceability',classification);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reconcile_telephony_transcripts()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE sid record;
BEGIN
 FOR sid IN SELECT DISTINCT a.parent_call_sid FROM telephony_call_attempts a
 LEFT JOIN inbound_calls i ON i.id=a.inbound_call_id AND i.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
 LEFT JOIN call_records c ON c.id=a.call_record_id AND c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
 WHERE (i.ended_at IS NOT NULL OR a.ended_at IS NOT NULL)
 AND (c.metadata->>'transcript_finalized_at' IS NULL
  OR (c.call_duration_seconds IS NULL AND a.talk_seconds>0))
 AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM telephony_transcript_segments s WHERE s.attempt_id=a.id)
  OR (a.direction='outbound' AND c.transcript_id IS NOT NULL AND nullif(trim(c.transcript_raw),'') IS NOT NULL))
 LOOP PERFORM finalize_telephony_transcript(sid.parent_call_sid); END LOOP;
 -- Only an earlier sale disposition can create an eligible request.
 FOR sid IN SELECT id FROM call_records WHERE compliance_requested_at IS NOT NULL
  AND public.is_compliance_sale(call_outcome)
 LOOP PERFORM public.refresh_sale_compliance_request(sid.id); END LOOP;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_llm_skipped_ticks(p_tenant_id uuid, p_user_id text, p_engine text, p_session_id uuid, p_count integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_engine IS NULL OR p_count IS NULL OR p_session_id IS NULL
    OR p_engine NOT IN ('MA', 'MEDSUP', 'ACA', 'U65') OR p_count NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid skip counter';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.usage_records (tenant_id, record_type, engine_name, request_id, quantity, metadata)
  VALUES (p_tenant_id, 'llm_skipped_ticks', p_engine, p_session_id, p_count,
    jsonb_build_object('event', 'silence_skip_counter', 'user_id', p_user_id, 'updated_at', now()))
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, engine_name, request_id) WHERE record_type = 'llm_skipped_ticks'
  DO UPDATE SET quantity = greatest(usage_records.quantity, EXCLUDED.quantity),
    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata;
END;
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF nullif(p_agent_id, '') IS NULL OR nullif(p_call_sid, '') IS NULL OR
     p_verified_call_sid IS DISTINCT FROM p_call_sid OR
     nullif(p_verified_account_sid, '') IS NULL OR
     p_twilio_status IS NULL OR
     p_twilio_status NOT IN ('completed', 'canceled', 'failed', 'busy', 'no-answer') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid verified call recovery evidence';
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.agent_availability AS a SET
    status = coalesce(a.resume_status, 'offline'),
    available = coalesce(a.resume_status, 'offline') = 'available',
    active_call_sid = NULL,
    resume_status = NULL,
    toggled_at = clock_timestamp()
  WHERE a.agent_id = p_agent_id
    AND a.active_call_sid = p_call_sid
    AND a.last_assigned_at <= clock_timestamp() - interval '2 minutes';
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.repair_telephony_record_links()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE r record;
BEGIN
 FOR r IN SELECT c.id,c.tenant_id,c.metadata FROM call_records c
   LEFT JOIN integration_link_issues issue ON issue.call_record_id=c.id
   WHERE metadata->>'telephony_call'='true' AND c.twilio_call_sid IS NULL
     AND metadata->>'twilio_call_sid' IS NOT NULL
     AND (issue.updated_at IS NULL OR issue.updated_at<now()-interval '1 minute')
   ORDER BY issue.updated_at NULLS FIRST,c.created_at LIMIT 100 LOOP
   BEGIN
    PERFORM link_telephony_call_record(r.id,r.tenant_id,r.metadata->>'twilio_call_sid',r.metadata->>'telephony_user_id');
   EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    INSERT INTO integration_link_issues(call_record_id,twilio_call_sid,reason)
      VALUES(r.id,r.metadata->>'twilio_call_sid','repair_error')
      ON CONFLICT(call_record_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=now();
   END;
 END LOOP;
END;
$function$

DECLARE identity record;
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('role',true)<>'service_role' OR NOT public.deployment_feature_enabled('RESHOP_LIST_ENABLED') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO identity FROM public.resolve_deployment_subject(p_actor,p_org);
 IF identity.tenant_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Membership required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON(e.contact_id,public.reshop_coverage(e.data->>'planType',e.data->>'contractId')) e.*,
   public.reshop_coverage(e.data->>'planType',e.data->>'contractId') coverage
  FROM public.enrollment_intakes e WHERE e.tenant_id=identity.tenant_id AND e.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT e.is_test_enrollment
  ORDER BY e.contact_id,public.reshop_coverage(e.data->>'planType',e.data->>'contractId'),e.submitted_at DESC,e.completed_at DESC,e.id DESC
 ), source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT e.id,e.contact_id,e.tenant_id,e.coverage,e.submitted_at,e.retention_started_at,e.data,
   ea.id agent_id,a.agent_slug,a.name agent_name,upper(btrim(e.data->>'contractId')) contract_id,
   CASE WHEN e.data->>'planId' ~ '^\d{1,3}$' THEN lpad(e.data->>'planId',3,'0') END plan_id,
   CASE WHEN e.data->>'segmentId' ~ '^\d{1,3}$' THEN lpad(e.data->>'segmentId',3,'0') END segment_id,
   public.reshop_year(e.data->>'effectiveDate') enrollment_year,coalesce(nullif(c.state,''),e.data->>'state') state,
   CASE WHEN c.county ~ '^\d{5}$' THEN c.county ELSE geo.county_fips END county_fips,
   coalesce(nullif(e.data->>'newCarrier',''),e.carrier_key) carrier,
   CASE WHEN e.data->>'premium' ~ '^\$?\d+(\.\d{1,2})?$' THEN replace(e.data->>'premium','$','') END premium
  FROM latest e JOIN public.contacts c ON c.id=e.contact_id AND c.tenant_id=e.tenant_id
  JOIN public.call_records cr ON cr.id=e.call_id AND cr.tenant_id=e.tenant_id
  JOIN public.enrolled_agents ca ON ca.id=cr.agent_id AND ca.tenant_id=e.tenant_id
  JOIN public.tenant_agents a ON a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND
   CASE WHEN nullif(e.data->>'writingAgentId','') IS NOT NULL THEN a.id::text=e.data->>'writingAgentId'
    WHEN nullif(e.data->>'writingAgentSlug','') IS NOT NULL THEN a.agent_slug=e.data->>'writingAgentSlug'
    WHEN nullif(e.data->>'aor','') IS NOT NULL THEN a.agent_slug=lower(replace(e.data->>'aor',' ','_'))
    ELSE a.clerk_user_id=ca.clerk_user_id END
  JOIN public.enrolled_agents ea ON ea.clerk_user_id=a.clerk_user_id AND ea.tenant_id=e.tenant_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(z.county_fips) county_fips FROM public.zip_county_crosswalk z WHERE z.state_code=c.state AND lower(z.county_name)=lower(c.county) HAVING count(DISTINCT z.county_fips)=1) geo ON true
  WHERE (p_id IS NULL OR e.id=p_id) AND (identity.authority='admin' OR identity.authority='agent' AND ea.id=identity.agent_id OR identity.authority='manager' AND ea.id=ANY(identity.team_agent_ids))
   AND NOT c.do_not_call AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.contacts d WHERE d.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND d.do_not_call AND (d.phone_hash=c.phone_hash OR public.normalize_phone_e164(d.phone)=public.normalize_phone_e164(c.phone)))
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.opportunities o JOIN public.pipeline_stages s ON s.id=o.stage_id AND s.tenant_id=o.tenant_id WHERE o.contact_id=c.id AND o.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND lower(s.name)='disenrolled')
 ), keyed AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT s.*,jsonb_build_array(contract_id,plan_id,segment_id,enrollment_year,state,county_fips,carrier,premium,coverage,CASE WHEN data->>'planType' IN ('HMO','PPO','HMO-POS','PFFS','MSA') THEN data->>'planType' END)::text fact_key FROM source s
 ), keys AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT fact_key, contract_id,plan_id,segment_id,enrollment_year,state,county_fips,carrier,premium,coverage,
   CASE WHEN data->>'planType' IN ('HMO','PPO','HMO-POS','PFFS','MSA') THEN data->>'planType' END recorded_type FROM keyed
 ), facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT k.*,coalesce(current_plan.plan_type,k.recorded_type) plan_type,
   coalesce(x.transitions,'[]') transitions,coalesce(next_plans.successors,'[]') successors,
   public.reshop_landscape_loaded(k.enrollment_year+1) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.plan_terminations w WHERE w.plan_year=k.enrollment_year+1) loaded
  FROM keys k
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT l.plan_type,l.carrier FROM public.reshop_plan_rows(k.enrollment_year,k.contract_id,k.plan_id) l WHERE true AND lpad(l.segment_id,3,'0')=k.segment_id AND l.county_fips=k.county_fips AND l.state_code=k.state LIMIT 1) current_plan ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('termination_type',w.termination_type,'source_status',w.source_status,'county_mapping_status',w.county_mapping_status,'county_fips',w.county_fips,'new_contract_id',w.new_contract_id,'new_plan_id',w.new_plan_id)) transitions
   FROM public.plan_terminations w WHERE w.plan_year=k.enrollment_year+1 AND w.old_contract_id=k.contract_id AND lpad(w.old_plan_id,3,'0')=k.plan_id
  ) x ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('contract_id',l.contract_id,'plan_id',lpad(l.plan_id,3,'0'),'segment_id',lpad(l.segment_id,3,'0'),'plan_type',l.plan_type,'monthly_premium',l.monthly_premium,'overall_star_rating',sr.overall_star_rating,'low_performing',sr.low_performing)) successors
   FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t->>'new_contract_id' contract_id,lpad(t->>'new_plan_id',3,'0') plan_id FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(x.transitions,'[]')) t WHERE t->>'termination_type'<>'terminated') targets CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.reshop_plan_rows(k.enrollment_year+1,targets.contract_id,targets.plan_id) l LEFT JOIN public.star_ratings_by_county sr ON sr.plan_year=k.enrollment_year+1 AND sr.contract_id=l.contract_id AND sr.county_fips=l.county_fips
   WHERE l.county_fips=k.county_fips AND l.state_code=k.state
    AND (l.contract_id=k.contract_id OR lower(btrim(l.carrier))=lower(btrim(coalesce(current_plan.carrier,k.carrier))))
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(x.transitions,'[]')) t WHERE t->>'termination_type'<>'terminated' AND t->>'new_contract_id'=l.contract_id AND lpad(t->>'new_plan_id',3,'0')=lpad(l.plan_id,3,'0') AND (t->>'county_fips'=k.county_fips OR t->>'county_fips' IS NULL))
    -- Crosswalk has no segment mapping. A same-plan renewal retains the exact
    -- enrolled segment; changed-plan successors expose their actual segments.
    AND (l.contract_id<>k.contract_id OR lpad(l.plan_id,3,'0')<>k.plan_id OR lpad(l.segment_id,3,'0')=k.segment_id)
  ) next_plans ON true
 ), compared AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT f.*,public.reshop_evaluate(jsonb_build_object('coverage',coverage,'year',enrollment_year,'county_fips',county_fips,'contract_id',contract_id,'plan_id',plan_id,'plan_type',plan_type,'premium',premium),transitions,successors,loaded) comparison FROM facts f
 ), permissions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT cr.contact_id,(array_agg(jsonb_build_object('on_file',cr.ptc_on_file,'date',cr.ptc_date,'expiry',cr.ptc_expiry) ORDER BY coalesce(cr.ptc_date::timestamptz,cr.call_start::timestamptz,cr.created_at) DESC,cr.id DESC))[1] ptc
  FROM public.call_records cr WHERE cr.tenant_id=identity.tenant_id AND cr.contact_id IN (SELECT contact_id FROM source) GROUP BY cr.contact_id
 )
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'contact_id',s.contact_id,'agent_id',s.agent_id,'agent',s.agent_name,'agent_slug',s.agent_slug,'carrier',s.carrier,'state',s.state,
  'coverage',s.coverage,'enrolled_at',s.submitted_at,'year',s.enrollment_year,'target_year',s.enrollment_year+1,'county_fips',s.county_fips,
  'current',jsonb_build_object('contract_id',s.contract_id,'plan_id',s.plan_id,'segment_id',s.segment_id,'plan_type',f.plan_type,'premium',s.premium),
  'successors',CASE WHEN f.loaded AND s.coverage IN ('MA','PDP') THEN f.successors ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,'cms_transitions',CASE WHEN f.loaded AND s.coverage IN ('MA','PDP') THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(t.value-ARRAY['new_contract_id','new_plan_id']),'[]') FROM jsonb_array_elements(f.transitions) t) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
  'permission',coalesce(p.ptc,'{}'),'review',jsonb_build_object('outcome',r.outcome,'actor',r.reviewed_by,'time',r.reviewed_at,'task_id',r.task_id))||f.comparison
 FROM keyed s JOIN compared f ON s.fact_key=f.fact_key
 LEFT JOIN public.reshop_reviews r ON r.enrollment_id=s.id AND r.target_year=s.enrollment_year+1
 LEFT JOIN permissions p ON p.contact_id=s.contact_id;
END $function$

routines.name: reshop_year
routines.arguments: p_date text
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reshop_year(p_date text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_date !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 RETURN extract(year FROM p_date::date)::integer;
EXCEPTION WHEN datetime_field_overflow OR invalid_datetime_format THEN RETURN NULL;
END $function$

routines.name: resolve_deployment_subject
routines.arguments: p_subject text, p_org text
routines.result: TABLE(tenant_id uuid, agent_id uuid, roster_id uuid, agent_slug text, authority text, team_agent_ids uuid[])
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_deployment_subject(p_subject text, p_org text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(tenant_id uuid, agent_id uuid, roster_id uuid, agent_slug text, authority text, team_agent_ids uuid[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH binding AS (
  SELECT d.tenant_id,e.id agent_id,r.id roster_id,r.agent_slug,
   CASE WHEN e.role='principal' OR a.authority='admin' THEN 'admin'
        WHEN a.authority='manager' THEN 'manager' ELSE 'agent' END authority,
   coalesce(a.team_agent_ids,'{}'::uuid[]) team_agent_ids
  FROM public.deployment_settings d
  JOIN public.tenants t ON t.id=d.tenant_id AND t.clerk_org_id=d.public_profile->>'organizationId'
  JOIN public.enrolled_agents e ON e.tenant_id=t.id AND e.clerk_user_id=p_subject AND e.is_active IS TRUE
  JOIN public.tenant_agents r ON r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.clerk_user_id=e.clerk_user_id AND r.is_active IS TRUE
  JOIN public.availability_agent_subjects s ON s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND s.clerk_user_id=r.clerk_user_id
   AND s.agent_slug=r.agent_slug AND s.clerk_org_id=t.clerk_org_id AND s.is_active IS TRUE
  LEFT JOIN public.deployment_authorities a ON a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.clerk_user_id=e.clerk_user_id
  WHERE d.singleton AND nullif(p_subject,'') IS NOT NULL AND p_subject<>'dev-bypass'
   AND (nullif(p_org,'') IS NULL OR p_org=t.clerk_org_id)
 ) SELECT * FROM binding WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM binding)=1;
$function$

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.retention_classification()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 NEW.retention_enrollment_evidence:=coalesce(NEW.retention_enrollment_evidence,false) OR
 (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.retention_enrollment_evidence) OR coalesce(NEW.enrollment_completed,false) OR coalesce(NEW.app_written,false) OR
 nullif(NEW.enrollment_confirmation_number,'') IS NOT NULL OR nullif(NEW.enrollment_code,'') IS NOT NULL OR nullif(NEW.sunfire_code,'') IS NOT NULL OR
 NEW.call_outcome IN ('enrolled','enrolled_pending_verification','partial_enrollment','sale_ancillary');
 NEW.retention_enrollment_evidence:=coalesce(NEW.retention_enrollment_evidence,false);
 NEW.retention_marketing_evidence:=coalesce(NEW.retention_marketing_evidence,false) OR
 (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.retention_marketing_evidence) OR NEW.retention_enrollment_evidence OR NEW.call_type IN ('sales','marketing') OR
 NEW.call_outcome IN ('interested_needs_info','application_in_progress');
 NEW.retention_marketing_evidence:=coalesce(NEW.retention_marketing_evidence,false);
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sale_compliance_transcript_ready(p_call call_records)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT p_call.call_end IS NOT NULL AND p_call.metadata->>'transcript_finalized_at' IS NOT NULL
 AND jsonb_typeof(p_call.transcript_diarized)='array'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_call.transcript_diarized)='array'
  THEN p_call.transcript_diarized ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) u WHERE nullif(trim(u->>'text'),'') IS NOT NULL)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM telephony_call_attempts a WHERE a.call_record_id=p_call.id AND a.ended_at IS NULL)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM media_stream_leases l JOIN telephony_call_attempts a ON a.id=l.attempt_id
  WHERE a.call_record_id=p_call.id AND l.expires_at>clock_timestamp());
$function$

    'detections',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)) FROM intent_detections d WHERE d.scoring_job_id=j.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'correctiveActions',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)) FROM corrective_actions a WHERE a.scorecard_id=c.id),'[]'::jsonb))

 RETURNS TABLE(chunk_id uuid, transcript_id uuid, chunk_text text, speaker text, topics text[], similarity double precision, agent_name text, call_date timestamp with time zone, product_line text, carrier text, disposition text, compliance_passed boolean)

 PERFORM public.audit_browser_evidence('transcript_chunks',NULL,'list',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.current_deployment_identity()));

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.seed_paragon_billing()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE inserted integer;
BEGIN
 INSERT INTO paragon_call_billing(parent_call_sid,tenant_id,source_id,ping_id,inbound_call_id,rate_per_call)
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.matched_call_sid) p.matched_call_sid,s.tenant_id,s.id,p.id,i.id,
   coalesce(p.rate_per_call,c.paragon_rate)
 FROM paragon_ping_decisions p JOIN lead_sources s ON s.id=p.source_id
 JOIN vendor_controls c ON c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id
 LEFT JOIN inbound_calls i ON i.twilio_call_sid=p.matched_call_sid AND i.tenant_id=s.tenant_id
 WHERE p.available AND p.matched_call_sid ~ '^CA[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$'
 AND s.name=public.bootstrap_vendor_source_name() AND s.type='publisher'
 ORDER BY p.matched_call_sid,p.received_at DESC,p.id DESC ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
 GET DIAGNOSTICS inserted=ROW_COUNT;
 UPDATE paragon_call_billing b SET inbound_call_id=i.id
 FROM inbound_calls i WHERE b.inbound_call_id IS NULL AND i.twilio_call_sid=b.parent_call_sid AND i.tenant_id=b.tenant_id;
 RETURN inserted;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_access_review(p_actor text, p_org text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE tenant uuid; answer jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF current_setting('role',true)<>'service_role' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Server required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT tenant_id INTO tenant FROM public.resolve_deployment_subject(p_actor,p_org) WHERE authority='admin';
 IF tenant IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Protected admin required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('roster',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'id',r.id,'subject',r.clerk_user_id,'name',r.name,'active',r.is_active,'role',to_jsonb(r)->>'role',
 'provisioned_at',to_jsonb(r)->>'created_at','last_activity',(SELECT max(t) FROM (
 SELECT occurred_at t FROM public.evidence_access_log WHERE actor_id=r.clerk_user_id AND tenant_id=tenant
 UNION ALL SELECT occurred_at FROM public.admin_action_log WHERE actor_id=r.clerk_user_id AND tenant_id=tenant
 UNION ALL SELECT occurred_at FROM public.operational_events WHERE subject='sha256:'||encode(extensions.digest(r.clerk_user_id,'sha256'),'hex')) activity),
 'last_access_change',(SELECT max(occurred_at) FROM public.admin_action_log l WHERE l.tenant_id=tenant AND
 l.action IN ('operator_tenant_agents','operator_deployment_authorities','operator_provision_roster','provision_deployment_roster') AND
 (l.target_id=r.id::text OR l.before_summary::text LIKE '%'||r.id::text||'%' OR l.after_summary::text LIKE '%'||r.id::text||'%')))) FROM public.tenant_agents r WHERE r.tenant_id=tenant),'[]'),
 'enrolled',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'subject',e.clerk_user_id,'active',e.is_active,'role',e.role,'created_at',e.created_at)) FROM public.enrolled_agents e WHERE e.tenant_id=tenant),'[]'),
 'authorities',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('subject',a.clerk_user_id,'authority',a.authority,'team',a.team_agent_ids)) FROM public.deployment_authorities a WHERE a.tenant_id=tenant),'[]')) INTO answer;
 RETURN answer;
END $function$

routines.arguments: p_tenant uuid, p_team uuid[]
routines.result: TABLE(agent_id uuid, name text, team text, status text, since timestamp with time zone, connected_at timestamp with time zone, attempt_id uuid, call_id uuid, direction text, call_type text, product_type text, flags jsonb, listen_available boolean)
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.supervisor_floor_rows(p_tenant uuid, p_team uuid[] DEFAULT NULL::uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(agent_id uuid, name text, team text, status text, since timestamp with time zone, connected_at timestamp with time zone, attempt_id uuid, call_id uuid, direction text, call_type text, product_type text, flags jsonb, listen_available boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 WITH roster AS (
 SELECT e.id,e.name,r.agent_slug,r.team FROM public.enrolled_agents e
 JOIN public.tenant_agents r ON r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.clerk_user_id=e.clerk_user_id AND r.is_active
 JOIN public.availability_agent_subjects m ON m.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND m.clerk_user_id=e.clerk_user_id AND m.agent_slug=r.agent_slug AND m.is_active
 JOIN LATERAL public.resolve_deployment_subject(e.clerk_user_id,NULL) binding ON binding.agent_id=e.id AND binding.tenant_id=e.tenant_id
 WHERE e.tenant_id=p_tenant AND e.is_active AND (p_team IS NULL OR e.id=ANY(p_team))
 ), facts AS (
 SELECT r.*,v.status manual,v.resume_status,v.active_call_sid,v.last_assigned_at,v.toggled_at,v.updated_at,
 a.id aid,a.call_record_id cid,a.direction dir,a.answered_at,a.created_at ringing_at,
 (SELECT (ev->>'at')::timestamptz FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c.metadata->'conference_events','[]')) ev WHERE ev->>'event'='customer_hold_changed' ORDER BY (ev->>'at')::timestamptz DESC LIMIT 1) hold_changed_at,cf.customer_held,cf.started_at conference_at,cf.call_id conference_id,c.call_type ctype,c.product_type product,
 w.ended_at wrap_at,ph.expires_at phone_until,ph.last_seen,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.telephony_call_attempts old LEFT JOIN public.call_records rec ON rec.id=old.call_record_id AND rec.tenant_id=old.tenant_id LEFT JOIN public.call_conferences conf ON conf.attempt_id=old.id AND conf.tenant_id=old.tenant_id WHERE old.tenant_id=p_tenant AND old.parent_call_sid=v.active_call_sid AND (rec.call_end IS NOT NULL OR conf.ended_at IS NOT NULL OR old.ended_at IS NOT NULL OR old.status IN ('completed','failed','canceled','no-answer','busy'))) stale_reservation
 FROM roster r LEFT JOIN public.agent_availability v ON v.agent_id=r.agent_slug
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT x.* FROM public.telephony_call_attempts x LEFT JOIN public.call_conferences conf ON conf.attempt_id=x.id
 LEFT JOIN public.call_records rec ON rec.id=x.call_record_id AND rec.tenant_id=x.tenant_id
 WHERE x.tenant_id=p_tenant AND (CASE WHEN conf.call_id IS NOT NULL THEN conf.owner_agent_id ELSE x.agent_id END)=r.agent_slug
 AND x.ended_at IS NULL AND x.status NOT IN ('completed','failed','canceled','no-answer','busy') AND rec.call_end IS NULL
 AND (conf.call_id IS NULL OR conf.ended_at IS NULL)
 ORDER BY (x.answered_at IS NOT NULL) DESC,x.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) a ON true
 LEFT JOIN public.call_records c ON c.id=a.call_record_id AND c.tenant_id=p_tenant
 LEFT JOIN public.call_conferences cf ON cf.attempt_id=a.id AND cf.tenant_id=p_tenant AND cf.ended_at IS NULL
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT max(expires_at) expires_at,max(expires_at)-interval '45 seconds' last_seen FROM public.agent_phone_sessions WHERE agent_id=r.agent_slug) ph ON true
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT coalesce(ended_at,updated_at) ended_at FROM public.call_wrap_ups WHERE tenant_id=p_tenant AND agent_id=r.id AND status='pending' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) w ON true
 ), states AS (
 SELECT *,CASE WHEN answered_at IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN customer_held THEN 'on_hold' ELSE 'on_call' END
 WHEN aid IS NOT NULL OR active_call_sid IS NOT NULL AND NOT stale_reservation THEN 'ringing'
 WHEN wrap_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'wrap_up'
 WHEN phone_until IS NULL OR phone_until<=statement_timestamp() THEN 'offline'
 WHEN stale_reservation AND manual='busy' THEN coalesce(resume_status,'offline')
 WHEN manual IN ('available','callbacks_only','busy') THEN manual ELSE 'offline' END display_status FROM facts
 )
 SELECT id,name,team,display_status,
 CASE WHEN display_status='on_hold' THEN coalesce(hold_changed_at,conference_at,answered_at) WHEN display_status='on_call' THEN coalesce(hold_changed_at,answered_at) WHEN display_status='ringing' THEN coalesce(ringing_at,last_assigned_at)
 WHEN display_status='wrap_up' THEN wrap_at WHEN display_status='offline' AND phone_until<=statement_timestamp() THEN phone_until WHEN display_status='offline' AND manual IS DISTINCT FROM 'offline' AND phone_until IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(toggled_at,updated_at) END,
 answered_at,aid,cid,dir,CASE WHEN ctype IN ('sales','marketing','service','general_service','customer_service','enrollment','follow_up','followup','retention','support','transfer') THEN ctype END,
 CASE WHEN product IN ('MA','MAPD','PDP','DSNP','CSNP','ISNP','MS','MEDSUP','ACA','U65','ANCILLARY') THEN product END,
 coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('category',category,'count',n) ORDER BY category) FROM (
 SELECT CASE WHEN f.issue_tag IN ('hard_stop_prohibited_claim','hard_stop_missing_prerequisite') THEN f.issue_tag ELSE 'other' END category,count(*) n FROM public.compliance_flags f JOIN public.sessions s ON s.id=f.session_id
 WHERE s.tenant_id=p_tenant AND s.agent_id=states.id AND s.call_record_id=states.cid AND s.ended_at IS NULL AND NOT f.addressed
 GROUP BY 1) flags),'[]'::jsonb),
 answered_at IS NOT NULL AND conference_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.media_stream_leases l WHERE l.attempt_id=aid AND l.expires_at>statement_timestamp())
 FROM states ORDER BY id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_post_call_record_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM post_call_requests WHERE session_id=NEW.session_id AND action IN ('finalize','wrap_up','recover')) THEN
 UPDATE call_records SET post_call_status=CASE NEW.status WHEN 'queued' THEN 'pending' WHEN 'running' THEN 'processing' ELSE NEW.status END,
 post_call_last_error=NEW.error_code WHERE session_id=NEW.session_id AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $function$

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_session_product_fields()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    IF NEW.flow IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.flow THEN
      NEW.product_line := CASE lower(NEW.flow)
        WHEN 'ma' THEN 'MA' WHEN 'medsup' THEN 'MedSup'
        WHEN 'aca' THEN 'ACA' WHEN 'u65' THEN 'U65' ELSE NEW.flow END;
    ELSIF NEW.product_line IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.product_line THEN
      NEW.flow := CASE lower(NEW.product_line)
        WHEN 'ms' THEN 'medsup' WHEN 'medsup' THEN 'medsup'
        ELSE lower(NEW.product_line) END;
    END IF;
  END IF;
  NEW.flow := coalesce(NEW.flow, CASE lower(NEW.product_line)
    WHEN 'ms' THEN 'medsup' WHEN 'medsup' THEN 'medsup'
    ELSE lower(NEW.product_line) END);
  NEW.product_line := coalesce(NEW.product_line, CASE lower(NEW.flow)
    WHEN 'ma' THEN 'MA' WHEN 'medsup' THEN 'MedSup'
    WHEN 'aca' THEN 'ACA' WHEN 'u65' THEN 'U65' ELSE NEW.flow END);
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.unresolved_post_call_error(p_session_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(failed.error_code,'processing_failed') FROM post_call_requests failed
 WHERE failed.session_id=p_session_id AND failed.status='failed'
 AND NOT (failed.action='finalize' AND failed.retry_request_key IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM post_call_requests saved WHERE saved.session_id=failed.session_id AND saved.request_key=failed.retry_request_key
 AND saved.status='completed' AND saved.result->>'transcript_id' IS NOT NULL
 AND saved.result->>'call_record_id'=failed.payload->>'call_record_id'))
 AND NOT (failed.action='checkpoint' AND coalesce(failed.error_code,'') IN ('worker_timeout','post_call_http_429','post_call_http_500','post_call_http_502','post_call_http_503','post_call_http_504')
   AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM post_call_requests saved
     WHERE saved.session_id=failed.session_id AND saved.sequence>failed.sequence
       AND saved.status='completed'
       AND saved.action IN ('checkpoint','finalize','wrap_up','recover')
       AND nullif(saved.result->>'transcript_id','') IS NOT NULL
       AND nullif(saved.result->>'call_record_id','') IS NOT NULL
       AND (nullif(failed.payload->>'call_record_id','') IS NULL
         OR failed.payload->>'call_record_id'=saved.result->>'call_record_id')
   ))
 ORDER BY failed.sequence DESC LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vendor_call_payload(p_call_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('aggregator_call_id',i.aggregator_call_id,'twilio_call_sid',i.twilio_call_sid,
   'publisher',i.publisher,'call_start_time',i.created_at,'caller_phone',i.from_number,
   'duration',CASE WHEN s.name=public.bootstrap_vendor_source_name() AND s.type='publisher' THEN f.billable_seconds ELSE coalesce(i.duration_seconds,r.call_duration_seconds,0) END,
   'disposition_code',CASE WHEN r.call_outcome='sale_ancillary' THEN 'sale'
      WHEN coalesce(r.call_outcome,i.status) IN ('mentally_unfit','possible_cognitive_impairment')
      THEN 'other' ELSE coalesce(r.call_outcome,i.status,'incomplete') END,
   'sale',coalesce(r.call_outcome IN ('enrolled','sale_ancillary'),false),
   'state',coalesce(i.confirmed_state,i.caller_state,r.metadata->>'state'),
   'wrong_state',i.wrong_state,'zip',i.confirmed_zip,
   'billing_dispute',CASE WHEN s.name=public.bootstrap_vendor_source_name() AND s.type='publisher' THEN coalesce(f.billing_dispute,false) ELSE i.wrong_state AND coalesce(i.duration_seconds,r.call_duration_seconds,0)>=90 END)
 FROM inbound_calls i LEFT JOIN call_records r ON r.id=i.call_record_id AND r.tenant_id=i.tenant_id LEFT JOIN lead_sources s ON s.id=i.lead_source_id AND s.tenant_id=i.tenant_id
 LEFT JOIN paragon_billing_facts f ON f.parent_call_sid=i.twilio_call_sid AND f.tenant_id=i.tenant_id
 WHERE i.id=p_call_id;
$function$

routines.name: whisper_customer_recordings
routines.arguments: p_call uuid, p_tenant uuid
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.whisper_customer_recordings(p_call uuid, p_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF recording_ingestion
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT r.* FROM public.recording_ingestion r
 JOIN public.call_participants p ON p.call_id=r.call_record_id AND p.role='customer' AND p.speaker='customer'
  AND p.twilio_call_sid=r.callback_call_sid AND p.recording_sid=r.recording_sid
 JOIN public.call_records c ON c.id=p.call_id AND c.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
 WHERE c.id=p_call AND c.tenant_id=p_tenant AND c.metadata->'supervisor_whisper'='true'::jsonb
 AND r.provider_status='completed' AND r.recording_source='StartCallRecordingAPI' AND r.recording_channels=2
 AND r.recording_duration_seconds>0 AND r.deletion_pending_at IS NULL
 AND (r.storage_path IS NOT NULL OR (r.account_sid IS NOT NULL AND r.recording_sid IS NOT NULL AND r.copy_status<>'absent'))
 ORDER BY r.provider_created_at,r.id
$function$

views.definition:
WITH targets AS (
         SELECT a.tenant_id,
            a.id AS attempt_id,
            a.inbound_call_id,
            a.call_record_id,
            a.parent_call_sid,
            a.direction,
            a.answered_at AS occurred_at,
            a.agent_id,
            COALESCE(c.recording_storage_path, i.recording_storage_path) AS legacy_storage_path
           FROM ((telephony_call_attempts a
             LEFT JOIN call_records c ON (((c.id = a.call_record_id) AND (c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id))))
             LEFT JOIN inbound_calls i ON (((i.id = a.inbound_call_id) AND (i.tenant_id = a.tenant_id))))
          WHERE (a.answered_at IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT i.tenant_id,
            NULL::uuid AS uuid,
            i.id,
            i.call_record_id,
            i.twilio_call_sid,
                CASE
                    WHEN (i.status = 'voicemail'::text) THEN 'voicemail'::text
                    ELSE 'inbound'::text
                END AS "case",
            COALESCE(i.answered_at, i.created_at) AS "coalesce",
            COALESCE(i.answered_agent_id, i.routed_agent_id) AS "coalesce",
            i.recording_storage_path
           FROM inbound_calls i
          WHERE (((i.answered_at IS NOT NULL) OR (i.status = 'voicemail'::text)) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM telephony_call_attempts a
                  WHERE (a.inbound_call_id = i.id)))))
        UNION ALL
         SELECT c.tenant_id,
            NULL::uuid AS uuid,
            NULL::uuid AS uuid,
            c.id,
            c.twilio_call_sid,
            c.call_direction,
            c.call_start,
            NULL::text AS text,
            c.recording_storage_path
           FROM call_records c
          WHERE ((c.twilio_call_sid IS NOT NULL) AND (c.call_duration_seconds > 0) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM telephony_call_attempts a
                  WHERE (a.call_record_id = c.id)))) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM inbound_calls i
                  WHERE (i.call_record_id = c.id)))))
        )
 SELECT t.tenant_id,
    t.attempt_id,
    t.inbound_call_id,
    t.call_record_id,
    t.parent_call_sid,
    t.direction,
    t.occurred_at,
    t.agent_id,
    t.legacy_storage_path,
        CASE
            WHEN ((s.stored > 0) OR (t.legacy_storage_path IS NOT NULL)) THEN 'call_record_unlinked'::text
            WHEN (s.total = 0) THEN 'no_callback'::text
            WHEN (s.absent = s.total) THEN 'provider_absent'::text
            WHEN (s.failed > 0) THEN 'copy_failed'::text
            ELSE 'copy_pending'::text
        END AS reason,
    s.total AS recording_count,
    s.stored AS stored_count
   FROM (targets t
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS total,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.copy_status = 'stored'::text)) AS stored,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.copy_status = 'absent'::text)) AS absent,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (r.copy_status = 'failed'::text)) AS failed
           FROM recording_ingestion r
          WHERE ((r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id) AND (((t.attempt_id IS NOT NULL) AND (r.attempt_id = t.attempt_id)) OR ((t.attempt_id IS NULL) AND (t.inbound_call_id IS NOT NULL) AND (r.inbound_call_id = t.inbound_call_id)) OR ((t.attempt_id IS NULL) AND (t.inbound_call_id IS NULL) AND (r.call_record_id = t.call_record_id))))) s)
  WHERE (((s.stored = 0) AND (t.legacy_storage_path IS NULL)) OR ((t.call_record_id IS NULL) AND (t.direction <> 'voicemail'::text)));

SELECT c.tenant_id,
    ((c.call_start AT TIME ZONE deployment_timezone()))::date AS day,
    count(*) AS enrollments,
    (count(*))::numeric AS expected_uploads,
    sum(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ix_uploads u
          WHERE ((u.call_id = c.id) AND (u.enrollment_key = (i.id)::text) AND (u.status = 'uploaded'::text)))) AS uploaded,
    sum(( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ix_uploads u
          WHERE ((u.call_id = c.id) AND (u.enrollment_key = (i.id)::text) AND (u.status = ANY (ARRAY['failed'::text, 'needs_attention'::text, 'duplicate_on_sunfire'::text]))))) AS failed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((NULLIF((i.data ->> 'sunfireCode'::text), ''::text) IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM ix_uploads u
          WHERE ((u.call_id = c.id) AND (u.enrollment_key = (i.id)::text) AND (u.last_error = 'invalid_sunfire_code'::text)))))) AS missing_codes
   FROM (call_records c
     JOIN enrollment_intakes i ON (((i.call_id = c.id) AND (i.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) AND (i.completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT i.is_test_enrollment))))
  WHERE ((i.carrier_key = 'UnitedHealthcare'::text) AND (upper((COALESCE(c.product_type, ''::character varying))::text) = 'MA'::text) AND (c.call_outcome = ANY (ARRAY['enrolled'::text, 'enrolled_pending_verification'::text])))

views.definition:
SELECT b.parent_call_sid,
    b.tenant_id,
    b.source_id,
    b.ping_id,
    b.inbound_call_id,
    b.account_sid,
    b.arrived_at,
    b.answered_at,
    b.ended_at,
    b.ring_seconds,
    b.talk_seconds,
    b.billable_seconds,
    b.rate_per_call,
    b.finalized_at,
    b.evidence,
    b.error_code,
    b.next_attempt_at,
    b.attempts,
    b.lease_token,
    b.lease_until,
    COALESCE(b.arrived_at, i.created_at) AS received_at,
    i.from_number AS caller_phone,
    i.caller_state,
    i.confirmed_state,
    i.confirmed_zip,
    COALESCE(i.wrong_state, false) AS wrong_state,
    ((COALESCE(i.wrong_state, false) OR COALESCE(b.duplicate_flag, i.duplicate_flag, false)) AND (b.billable_seconds >= 90)) AS billing_dispute,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(i.aggregator_call_id, ''::text), NULLIF(p.vendor_call_id, ''::text)) AS vendor_call_id,
    COALESCE(r.vendor_disposition, r.call_outcome, i.status, 'incomplete'::text) AS disposition,
    COALESCE(r.app_written, false) AS app_written,
    COALESCE(i.confirmed_state, i.caller_state, (r.metadata ->> 'state'::text), 'unknown'::text) AS state,
    COALESCE((b.billable_seconds >= 90), false) AS is_billable,
        CASE
            WHEN (b.billable_seconds >= 90) THEN b.rate_per_call
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS amount_due,
    COALESCE(b.duplicate_flag, i.duplicate_flag, false) AS duplicate_flag,
    COALESCE(b.duplicate_prior_call_id, i.duplicate_prior_call_id) AS duplicate_prior_call_id
   FROM ((((paragon_call_billing b
     JOIN paragon_ping_decisions p ON (((p.id = b.ping_id) AND (p.source_id = b.source_id) AND p.available AND (p.matched_call_sid = b.parent_call_sid))))
     JOIN lead_sources s ON (((s.id = b.source_id) AND (s.tenant_id = b.tenant_id) AND (s.name = bootstrap_vendor_source_name()) AND (s.type = 'publisher'::text))))
     LEFT JOIN inbound_calls i ON (((i.id = b.inbound_call_id) AND (i.tenant_id = b.tenant_id) AND (i.twilio_call_sid = b.parent_call_sid))))
     LEFT JOIN call_records r ON (((r.id = i.call_record_id) AND (r.tenant_id = b.tenant_id))));

views.name: v_call_combine_facts
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    tenant_id,
    parent_call_id,
    contact_id,
    COALESCE(call_start, created_at) AS occurred_at,
    ( SELECT max(r.recording_duration_seconds) AS max
           FROM recording_ingestion r
          WHERE ((r.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) AND (r.provider_status = 'completed'::text) AND ((r.call_record_id = c.id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM inbound_calls i
                  WHERE ((i.call_record_id = c.id) AND (i.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) AND (i.id = r.inbound_call_id)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM telephony_call_attempts a
                  WHERE ((a.call_record_id = c.id) AND (a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) AND (a.id = r.attempt_id))))))) AS recording_seconds,
    ( SELECT (sum(a.talk_seconds))::integer AS sum
           FROM telephony_call_attempts a
          WHERE ((a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'failed'::text, 'busy'::text, 'no-answer'::text])) AND ((a.call_record_id = c.id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM inbound_calls i
                  WHERE ((i.call_record_id = c.id) AND (i.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) AND (i.id = a.inbound_call_id))))))) AS talk_seconds
   FROM call_records c;

views.name: v_call_log
views.definition:
SELECT e.log_id,
    e.call_record_id,
    e.inbound_call_id,
    e.tenant_id,
    e.occurred_at,
    e.direction,
    e.contact_id,
    e.contact_name,
    e.contact_phone,
        CASE
            WHEN (children.n > 0) THEN (COALESCE(f.talk_seconds, 0) + COALESCE(children.talk, 0))
            ELSE e.duration_seconds
        END AS duration_seconds,
    e.agent,
    e.disposition,
    e.recording_url,
    e.recording_storage_path,
    e.compliance_score,
    e.transcript_preview,
    e.agent_notes,
    e.attempt_id,
    f.talk_seconds AS original_talk_seconds,
    (children.n)::integer AS combined_count
   FROM ((v_call_log_entries e
     LEFT JOIN v_call_combine_facts f ON (((f.id = e.call_record_id) AND (f.tenant_id = e.tenant_id))))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS n,
            (sum(child.talk_seconds))::integer AS talk
           FROM v_call_combine_facts child
          WHERE ((child.parent_call_id = e.call_record_id) AND (child.tenant_id = e.tenant_id))) children ON (true))
  WHERE (f.parent_call_id IS NULL);

views.name: v_call_log_entries
views.definition:
WITH measured_records AS (
         SELECT telephony_call_attempts.tenant_id,
            telephony_call_attempts.call_record_id,
            (sum(telephony_call_attempts.talk_seconds))::integer AS duration_seconds
           FROM telephony_call_attempts
          WHERE ((telephony_call_attempts.call_record_id IS NOT NULL) AND (telephony_call_attempts.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'failed'::text, 'busy'::text, 'no-answer'::text])))
          GROUP BY telephony_call_attempts.tenant_id, telephony_call_attempts.call_record_id
        ), measured_inbound AS (
         SELECT telephony_call_attempts.tenant_id,
            telephony_call_attempts.inbound_call_id,
            (sum(telephony_call_attempts.talk_seconds))::integer AS duration_seconds
           FROM telephony_call_attempts
          WHERE ((telephony_call_attempts.inbound_call_id IS NOT NULL) AND (telephony_call_attempts.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'failed'::text, 'busy'::text, 'no-answer'::text])))
          GROUP BY telephony_call_attempts.tenant_id, telephony_call_attempts.inbound_call_id
        )
 SELECT ('cr-'::text || (c.id)::text) AS log_id,
    c.id AS call_record_id,
    NULL::uuid AS inbound_call_id,
    c.tenant_id,
    COALESCE(c.call_start, c.created_at) AS occurred_at,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(lower((c.call_direction)::text), ''::text), 'outbound'::text) AS direction,
    c.contact_id,
    NULLIF(btrim(concat_ws(' '::text, ct.first_name, ct.last_name)), ''::text) AS contact_name,
    ct.phone AS contact_phone,
    measured.duration_seconds,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(c.writing_agent, ''::text), (c.agent_name)::text) AS agent,
        CASE
            WHEN c.enrollment_completed THEN 'connected'::text
            WHEN (lower(COALESCE(c.call_outcome, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY[''::text, 'enrolled'::text, 'completed'::text, 'connected'::text])) THEN 'connected'::text
            ELSE lower(c.call_outcome)
        END AS disposition,
    c.recording_url,
    c.recording_storage_path,
    score.overall_score AS compliance_score,
    "left"(c.transcript_raw, 200) AS transcript_preview,
    c.agent_notes,
    NULL::uuid AS attempt_id
   FROM (((call_records c
     LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON (((ct.id = c.contact_id) AND (ct.tenant_id = c.tenant_id))))
     LEFT JOIN compliance_scorecards score ON (((score.id = c.compliance_scorecard_id) AND (score.tenant_id = c.tenant_id))))
     LEFT JOIN measured_records measured ON (((measured.call_record_id = c.id) AND (measured.tenant_id = c.tenant_id))))
  WHERE ((c.contact_id IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM inbound_calls i
          WHERE ((i.call_record_id = c.id) AND (i.tenant_id = c.tenant_id))))) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM telephony_call_attempts a
          WHERE ((a.call_record_id = c.id) AND (a.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) AND (a.direction = 'outbound'::text))))))
UNION ALL
 SELECT ('ic-'::text || (i.id)::text) AS log_id,
    i.call_record_id,
    i.id AS inbound_call_id,
    i.tenant_id,
    i.created_at AS occurred_at,
    'inbound'::text AS direction,
    i.contact_id,
    NULLIF(btrim(concat_ws(' '::text, ct.first_name, ct.last_name)), ''::text) AS contact_name,
    COALESCE(ct.phone, i.from_number) AS contact_phone,
    measured.duration_seconds,
    i.routed_agent_id AS agent,
        CASE i.status
            WHEN 'accepted'::text THEN 'connected'::text
            WHEN 'completed'::text THEN 'connected'::text
            WHEN 'voicemail'::text THEN 'voicemail'::text
            WHEN 'declined'::text THEN 'declined'::text
            ELSE 'missed'::text
        END AS disposition,
    i.recording_url,
    i.recording_storage_path,
    score.overall_score AS compliance_score,
    "left"(c.transcript_raw, 200) AS transcript_preview,
    c.agent_notes,
    NULL::uuid AS attempt_id
   FROM ((((inbound_calls i
     LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON (((ct.id = i.contact_id) AND (ct.tenant_id = i.tenant_id))))
     LEFT JOIN call_records c ON (((c.id = i.call_record_id) AND (c.tenant_id = i.tenant_id))))
     LEFT JOIN compliance_scorecards score ON (((score.id = c.compliance_scorecard_id) AND (score.tenant_id = i.tenant_id))))
     LEFT JOIN measured_inbound measured ON (((measured.inbound_call_id = i.id) AND (measured.tenant_id = i.tenant_id))))
UNION ALL
 SELECT ('ta-'::text || (a.id)::text) AS log_id,
    a.call_record_id,
    NULL::uuid AS inbound_call_id,
    a.tenant_id,
    a.created_at AS occurred_at,
    'outbound'::text AS direction,
    a.contact_id,
    NULLIF(btrim(concat_ws(' '::text, ct.first_name, ct.last_name)), ''::text) AS contact_name,
    COALESCE(ct.phone, a.to_number) AS contact_phone,
        CASE
            WHEN (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'failed'::text, 'busy'::text, 'no-answer'::text])) THEN a.talk_seconds
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS duration_seconds,
    a.agent_id AS agent,
        CASE
            WHEN (a.answered_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 'connected'::text
            WHEN (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'failed'::text, 'busy'::text, 'no-answer'::text])) THEN 'missed'::text
            ELSE 'ringing'::text
        END AS disposition,
    recording.recording_url,
    recording.storage_path AS recording_storage_path,
    score.overall_score AS compliance_score,
    "left"(c.transcript_raw, 200) AS transcript_preview,
    c.agent_notes,
    a.id AS attempt_id
   FROM ((((telephony_call_attempts a
     LEFT JOIN contacts ct ON (((ct.id = a.contact_id) AND (ct.tenant_id = a.tenant_id))))
     LEFT JOIN call_records c ON (((c.id = a.call_record_id) AND (c.tenant_id = a.tenant_id))))
     LEFT JOIN compliance_scorecards score ON (((score.id = c.compliance_scorecard_id) AND (score.tenant_id = a.tenant_id))))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.recording_url,
            r.storage_path
           FROM recording_ingestion r
          WHERE ((r.tenant_id = a.tenant_id) AND (r.attempt_id = a.id) AND (r.provider_status = 'completed'::text))
          ORDER BY (r.copy_status = 'stored'::text) DESC, r.provider_created_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.first_seen_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) recording ON (true))
  WHERE (a.direction = 'outbound'::text);

views.name: v_paragon_residence_review
views.definition:
SELECT j.inbound_call_id,
    i.call_record_id,
    j.tenant_id,
    i.twilio_call_sid,
    i.created_at,
    i.status AS call_status,
    j.capture,
    j.metadata,
    j.attempts,
    j.last_error,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(((j.metadata ->> 'ambiguous'::text))::boolean, false) THEN 'ambiguous_residence'::text
            WHEN (j.capture = '{}'::jsonb) THEN 'no_valid_residence'::text
            ELSE 'capture_retry'::text
        END AS review_reason
   FROM (paragon_residence_jobs j
     JOIN inbound_calls i ON (((i.id = j.inbound_call_id) AND (i.tenant_id = j.tenant_id))))
  WHERE ((i.status = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'declined'::text, 'canceled'::text, 'failed'::text, 'no-answer'::text, 'busy'::text, 'voicemail'::text, 'rejected'::text])) AND ((j.capture = '{}'::jsonb) OR COALESCE(((j.metadata ->> 'ambiguous'::text))::boolean, false) OR (j.last_error IS NOT NULL)));
